192003.description:
Luca is a wizard who lives deep in the forest. He conjures a monster out of the darkness and gives it the name "Yug," without explaining why. Yug moves in with Luca, but in order to maintain his human form, Yug needs to make intimate contact with Luca. And that's when he feels as if Luca is seeing “someone else” through him…

(Source: Gentousha, translated)

title.native: シャンパンタワーの向こう側

192006.description:
When delinquent transfer student Ban Tae-Hyeon, rumored to be the brawler at the center of a schoolyard fight, walks into class, the strict and upright Kang Hyeon-Beom makes it his mission to keep him in check. Determined to reform Tae-Hyeon into a model student, Hyeon-Beom starts watching his every move… only to find himself slowly drawn into Tae-Hyeon’s orbit. As the line between discipline and friendship starts to blur, could Hyeon-Beom really be the one getting “reformed” instead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

192013.description:
Take a look at this—!!

[Saving the World at the Gym!]

The year is 20XX. With the invasion of monsters straight out of a B-movie, humanity opens its eyes to a new power! Among the heroes who ooze strength and power without having to work out is a "tiger" who guards the Stronger Gym... No, it’s not a tiger, it’s a man wearing a tiger-patterned t-shirt and pants! Today, he greets his gym babies with joy like any other day.

"What? A gym baby?! Don't be scared. Come on in!"

Come watch the main character and his Stronger Gym friends cultivate a healthy mind and a healthy body!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

192015.description:
Lee Ho-Yeon, known in-game as "White Jack," starts playing the MMORPG Lunatic with a skilled friend but quits after struggling with controls and losing motivation. Years later, frustrated by repeated university entrance exams, he logs back in for stress relief and unexpectedly meets the game’s top-ranking player, Kim Hee-Ho ("Monaka").Despite his foul temper and aloof reputation, Hee-Ho helps Ho-Yeon improve. When Hee-Ho leaves his guild due to conflicts and joins "21," the small guild Ho-Yeon inherited, their ranking quickly rises. Rumors spread that they are dating since Hee-Ho is uncharacteristically warm toward Ho-Yeon.

To gain a game bonus, they register as an in-game couple, but no one believes it is just for the rewards. When a rival guild challenges them to a war, even the usually support-focused Ho-Yeon is forced to fight. He agrees to meet Hee-Ho offline for training but instead receives a real-life confession. They begin dating. The twist is that Ho-Yeon has been using a female avatar. When Hee-Ho proudly introduces his in-game partner, the truth comes out, sparking rumors that Ho-Yeon was pretending to be a girl.

What started as a game partnership turns into a real relationship. But between guild conflicts, public scrutiny, and real-life pressures, Ho-Yeon struggles to keep up. With Hee-Ho’s unwavering support, he fights to protect both their guild and their growing bond.

(Source: Lezhin US)

192016.description:
After years of devotion, Si-Woo’s boyfriend betrays him; then, the company he worked so hard at goes under. Feeling totally defeated, Si-Woo escapes into a game world just to take a break from reality. There, he meets a newbie named Woo-Jin, whose kind advice and hard-working attitude inspire Si-Woo to move on from his past and start living with purpose again. Determined never to fall for someone who’ll hurt him again, Si-Woo makes a vow to his friend: No love, no dating. Ever again! But when he meets his new boss, Si-Woo’s willpower will be put to the ultimate test…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

synonyms: I Want to Eat Three Meals a Day

title.native: 一日三食絶対食べたい

192018.description:
Koyomi has always lived a serious life. When she visits her cousin, a gynecologist, for menstrual problems, she is given the unexpected suggestion of "egg freezing." She makes a big decision and starts egg freezing treatment, but perhaps due to the effects of hormones, she begins to experience strange sensations of being aroused by the opposite sex...!? The bright and positive new Koyomi encounters various men through experiences that Koyomi would never have imagined, such as "matching apps" and "female brothels"...!?

(Source: Shiori-on, translated)

192020.description:
As a method actor, Do-Ha has always poured himself into his roles. For him, acting is an outlet he uses to deal with his difficult upbringing and the lingering struggles with self-worth that resulted from it. But one day, when Do-Ha collapses after filming only to wake up and find himself transmigrated into the world of the screenplay and inhabiting the very character he had been playing, his acting chops are about to be put to the test. Not only will Do-Ha have to give a convincing enough performance to fool everyone into believing he truly is the King’s concubine, he must also find a way to change the fate of his character who, according to the screenplay, is slated for an untimely demise. The only problem is, there’s just one way for Do-Ha to save his own neck, and that’s to win the affections of the King, who is proving to be a far cry from the gentleman he was written to be. Will Do-Ha somehow manage to come out unscathed, or will this be curtains for him?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Ma nouvelle vie de concubin oméga
En el cuerpo de la concubina del rey
オメガ愛妻に転生した

title.native: 期末試験前也～双子ちゃん～

192022.description:
Wealth, beauty, power… Grace had everything in her hands from the day she was born. Then she got herself banished for single-handedly fighting against 17 nobles. After her yearlong exile, Grace returns to find trouble has found its way into her home – her mother had been driven out of the family, and her father now has a new wife and daughter. But to make the dysfunctional family even worse, Grace’s new stepsister frames her, and the servants openly defy her.

“I’ll show them why I got banished in the first place!”

Can Grace use her wild antics to slam the door shut when trouble comes knocking?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: Quand le malheur frappe à la porte

192031.description:
Yumekawa Moe pretends to be normal at work when in reality she is a hardcore otaku inexperienced in love, her ideal boyfriend being her MMO character "Fantasista・Yukimaru". That was until one day, Yumekawa encountered her co-worker Kusakabe Chiharu who looked exactly like him, as he was being bothered by his boss to attend a marriage interview. She promptly jumped into the conversation, unknowing that Kusakabe was also hiding the fact that he was an otaku! Through a misunderstanding, the two ended up being confused for a couple, but somehow decided to keep up the act in order to preserve their current way of life...!?
WIth that, their "fake relationship" has begun. How long will their secrets last!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

192032.description:
The hit game Nukitashi returns with its second long-form manga adaptation!!

“I Can’t Betray Rei-chan, Can I?”

The story is set on Seiran Island, a paradise of lust where the “Perverted Law” was enacted to combat population decline.

Being a virgin equals to punishment!?

Hinami Watarai, a virgin unable to engage in lewdness even on such a twisted island, is approached by a secret organization aiming to dismantle the law: the anti-copulation front.

However, her best friend is Rei Tadasugawa—the discipline committee president and a enforcer of the pervertion.

Should she reject the organization… or betray her best friend?

A new Nukitashi tale begins!!
synonyms: Nukitashi R - I Live on an Island Straight from a Fap Game, What on Earth Should I do? R
ぬきたしR－抜きゲーみたいな島に住んでるわたしはどうすりゃいいですか？R
Nukitashi R: Nukige Mitai na Shima ni Sunderu Watashi wa Dou Surya Ii desu ka? R

192033.description:
Yoshino is a university student who works part-time as a house cleaner. One day, while cleaning a luxurious mansion, she ends up making midnight snack for the owner. What Yoshino makes is a sloppy risotto made with expired ingredients. However, for some reason, the owner likes it and she ends up becoming the midnight snack maker for the mansion.

(Source: Alphapolis, translated)

192034.description: Cross Visch, an ordinary villager, somehow ended up joining the hero's party. Cross is an ordinary person with no special powers. And yet, for some reason, the heroes truly considered Cross to be a member of their party. There was no way he would be kicked out of the party. That's why Cross continued to worry. What could a useless person like him do as part of the hero's party? And then... Cross came to understand his own role. At the moment the Demon King cast his magic at the hero as he was dying...

title.native: 追放されなかった男　～二度目の人生は土下座から始まりました～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sarenakatta Otoko: Nidome no Jinsei wa Dogeza kara Hajimarimashita

192035.description:
To him, the world was nothing but disappointments—heroes spouting empty catchphrases during battle, small-time villains committing petty crimes, classmates only knowing how to follow the herd, and his own weak, miserable self.

So, the boy yearned to change himself and the world by becoming aloof, noble, and strong—the ultimate Supervillain!

A new story from Koume Fujichika, the author behind "The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses"!

(Source: Manga UP!)

192036.description: For example, 26 cats are killed every day. For example, 6 dogs are killed every day. There are people who struggle day and night to reduce the number of animals killed for various reasons - and there are "heroes" in every world!

192037.description:
Eguchi Hibiki is a manga artist who has knowledge, but no understanding of erotica.
As Hibiki struggles with what exactly erotica is, she meets Yozaki Mia, a succubus who is also struggling with eroticism.
The two similar people decide to work together to understand "true eroticism," but...

title.native: 江口さんちの純情サキュバス

synonyms: The Reincarnated Dimensional Mage Wants to Stand Out While Keeping His Identity Hidden, The Reincarnated Spatial Mage Wants to Stand Out Being Masked His Identity!

title.romaji: Tensei shita Kuukan Mahoutsukai wa Shoutai Kakushite Medachitai!

192043.description:
Takato, an office worker, wakes up in an unfamiliar forest. After working overtime every day, he collapses into bed, but... Without knowing why, Takato encounters a slave hunter and panics, but what appears before him is... his favorite character, Dalestia!? Takato has been reincarnated into the world of the otome game "Dragon's Goddess". When he is protected by the knights led by Dalestia, the capture targets start to say sweet things to him for some reason...? The fierce love of the strongest knights, the twin wings, is unstoppable!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 巻き添えで異世界召喚されたおれは、最強騎士団に拾われる
title.romaji: Makizoe de Isekai Shoukan Sareta Ore wa, Saikyou Kishidan ni Hirowareru

192044.description:
It's been four years since Miya's stepfather married her mother, and every day since then he's taken her body by force. With her mother turning a blind eye to their comforting new life, Miya makes a wish on a tanzaku slip hoping that instead of a gross old man, she'll get a cute little sister she can play with. As her stepfather wakes up in the body of a young girl, Miya's wish comes true, and it's about time she has her fun.

(Source: Fakku!)

192045.description:
Milliana Pearl lived happily with her fiancé, Prince Julius, until she was accused of killing the king and sentenced to execution. In her last moments, an unknown voice offers her a chance to change her fate by living 1,000 lives. After meeting the conditions, Milliana returns to her original life. As she attempts to alter her past and save her loved ones, she uncovers hidden secrets and discovers that, to succeed, she must live without forming relationships, challenging her deepest desires.

(Source: Tapas)

192046.description:
Shintani Kenichi's heart flutters like a high school girl when he sees Wakatsuki Hayato, a student from another school, on the same train every morning. Shintani's heart is pierced by Wakatsuki, a popular boy who boasts that he will never confess his feelings to someone himself, but one day Wakatsuki sees him crying on the train!

This is the first comic book to depict the straightforward love stories of real-life boys, including a sparkling youthful love story that will make your heart flutter with the sincere "crying faces."

(Source: Okura Shuppan)
synonyms: I Want to Make You Cry!

192047.description:
What happens when a dull corporate slave and a guy suspected of being a sugar baby meet?! Maeda Ato, who came to Harajuku, a town for young people, to do research for a job, gets lost in the unfamiliar city and is saved by Nanase, a fashionable guy who looks like a celebrity. Maeda is attracted to Nanase's kindness, but it seems he has a secret about his "adult job"...?

A bittersweet, adult heart-pounding BL from the video creator group "BL Skip"!

(Source: Live Comics, translated)
synonyms: How Much Would Your KISS Be?

title.native: キスのおねだん！～社畜リーマンとパパ活男子～
title.romaji: Kiss no Onedan!: Shachiku Riiman to Papa Katsu Danshi

192048.description:
Bar S is an extraordinary bar run by three vibrant individuals: Goo Jun-Oh, a talented young chef; Go Yul, the magnetic bartender and manager; and Yoon Jung-Chan, a cheerful part-timer. Their group dynamic, though occasionally complicated, keeps the bar thriving—until the arrival of Ivan, a charming and enigmatic customer who stirs up emotions and rivalries within the group. His presence disrupts their balance, setting off a whirlwind of tension, passion, and intrigue, as the four navigate their intertwined relationships in this unique and captivating tale.

(Source: Lezhin US)

192049.description:
For weeks, a mysterious man has been setting Gyeol’s dreams on fire. By day, Gyeol lives a quiet life as a construction worker. But after locking eyes with a stranger at a job site, his nights are consumed by vivid, erotic dreams that leave him shaken - and wanting more. When he unexpectedly runs into the man again, reality begins to feel just as charged as his fantasies. The stranger introduces himself as Ye-Sung: handsome, magnetic, and impossible to read. His smile is too perfect, his gaze to knowing. He crosses lines without hesitation, drawing Gyeol into a game with no clear rules. As tension smolders between them, Gyeol finds himself spiraling deeper into Ye-Sung’s world, unable to tell where desire ends and danger begins. But play with fire too long, and one is bound to get burned.

(Source: Lezhin US)

192050.description:
Ael, a mermaid with a kind and upright personality, meets the lost mermaid Ort one day while swimming in the sea and takes him in. The young Ort grew up well under Ael's care, but his obsession with Ael became so strong that he continued to hover around Ael even after becoming an adult... Unable to stand by any longer, Ael tries to persuade Ort to become independent, but Ort is furious that Ael, whom he thought of as his companion, is trying to send him far away. In the end, Ort makes Ael feel firsthand how precious he is to him... Ael is gradually losing his body and mind to Ort, who was like a son and younger brother to him, and Ort does not want to let him go. What will be the end of their relationship?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

192051.description:
Tae-Wan, a blunt, single, and popular dessert YouTuber. One early morning, he takes Ji-An into his house, who is worried about a kitten in the yard while soaking wet from the rain. Tae-Wan, who secretly has feelings for Ji-An, who usually takes care of the cat from beyond the fence, becomes very nervous, and Ji-An begins to lightly seduce Tae-Wan while teasing him... After a hot night, Ji-An runs away without contacting him or making another appointment?!

The erotic romance between Ji-An, who is rich but naive and light-hearted, and Tae-Wan, who is serious but sincere about everything!

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

192052.description:
Yesol Kim has a celebrity crush. Okay, an obsession, but who doesn’t fantasize about getting intimate with movie stars? It didn’t mean anything was out of the ordinary—at least, not until a succubus interrupted her fantasies to tell her she could make men do whatever she wanted in the pursuit of some naughty fun. It couldn’t possibly have been more than a dream... But she doesn’t have anything to lose by testing it out either, does she? And if it is real, just how far can she take this power?

(Source: Tapas)

As old feelings resurface and tension builds, the path to a reunion seems possible—but it won't come without its challenges.

192064.description:
“In times like these, your face comes to mind.”

Shinta is an introverted virgin office worker who is self conscious about his looks — and currently obsessed with having VR sex in a virtual world. In VR, he is the handsome high schooler Makoto with a fulfilling school and sex life. He became friends with benefits with his classmate Aki, and his time with him became the only thing he looked forward to.

In the virtual world, it is prohibited to share information about real life, so he can only see Aki online. In reality, he is made fun of by his coworkers and overworked by his boss. With these days where he feels the huge gap between his real and VR life, Shinta begins to desire to meet Aki in real life.

(Source: G-Walk, translated)

Debut One-Shot of Yukari Ichijo.

192078.description:
It all started with a retirement. A legend in the underworld of killers and assassins, Sihyeok Cha, otherwise known as “The Red Shirt,” leaves a life of violence behind for his loving wife Miju and their unborn child. Little did he expect, however, that bonds made in blood cannot be so easily erased. When tragedy strikes, Sihyeok is dragged back into the deadly struggle between mob factions… and the fight is far from over.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: มัจจุราชชุดแดง

192079.description:
Lorena chose death to take revenge on the husband who ruined her life. Thrown back in time, she is determined to rewrite her destiny, protect her family, and destroy her husband. There’s only one way to win: a scandalous divorce.

“I need a wild dog… because I’m going to hunt down a hound.”

A dangerous alliance. A deadly deal. Will she be able to take everything back this time?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: คมเขี้ยวชำระแค้น

192080.description:
The master chosen by the Holy Sword, 'Nike', is the only human and omega to survive the battle with the Demon World. However, to the Demons, human omegas are nothing more than the sweetest and most delicious prey. Nike, who was offered as a sacrifice to the Demon King, becomes pregnant and gives birth to the cute mixed-blood 'Nikrom'.

"I want to find my father."

Although the child has Demon blood flowing through his veins, he wants to find the child's father for the sake of his beloved Nichrome's future. The only hint is the pattern on his chest. Will Nike be able to successfully find Nichrome's father? Find the Demon! Mission Start!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: Let's Find Dad in the Demon King's Castle!

title.native: 海にいる黄色い船から君へ
title.romaji: Umi ni Iru Kiiroi Fune kara Kimi e

192082.description:
Kim Jun-Kyung, who entered a prestigious high school with great difficulty despite her poor family circumstances, starts working part-time at a cleaning company to continue attending school without asking for help from others, and meets a man named Isak at the first house he cleans. A big house and luxurious items… Kim Jun-Kyung feels deeply drawn to Isak, who lives the wealthy life he had dreamed of, but is lonely and isolated like himself, and Isak also begins to hover around Kim Jun-Kyung…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

192083.description:
Cursed from birth, Estella has lived her entire life in quarantine. One day, the first-born princess of the Blaze Kingdom is sent away as a hostage to the imperial palace, where she's meant to meet a tragic end... But wait, Estella has a secret. With memories of her past life, where she read this story as a novel, she has a chance to change her fate and survive. Her plan? Charm the ruthless Emperor Tariq Winter, uncover the secrets of the nobles, find the Hourglass of the Time Traveler, and flee for freedom!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

title.native: 没落した王女には回帰が必要です

Tsukumo Mutsumi debut One-Shot
Note : featured in Ribon DX 1976 Spring issue

192087.description:
The innocent, cute, and smart Snowpea was on the verge of being beaten to death by her foster father when she heard her master's voice. It guided her to call her youngest uncle, which led to her eight bigshot uncles arriving with a vengeance! Now, living a new life, Snowpea just wants to be fed, but unexpectedly, her eight uncles all want to spoil her! And in the end, her powerful CEO real daddy descends like a god from the heavens to treat her like a little princess, making her the envy of the entire world.

(Source: Webcomics)

title.native: 福宝三岁半，她被八个舅舅团宠了
title.romaji: Fu Bao San Sui Ban, Ta Bei Ba Ge Juijui Tuan Chong Liao

192089.description:
Hang-Ah is a goddess that has protected the kingdom of Hae since it's foundation, and it is due to her blessing that the Hae kingdom has prospered for a thousand years. However, after a thousand years, the blessing has disappeared, and various disasters hit the kingdom.

(Source: Lalatoon)

192090.description:
Despite being born into the noble Aldaran family, Michelle endured a miserable childhood. After losing his wife, Michelle's father drowned his sorrows and bankrupted the family. He then sold Michelle off to the wealthy Barthelemy family where she suffered horrible mistreatment. Now all grown up, Michelle was arranged to marry into a new family, until the young count Raphael appeared out of nowhere and bought her for an outrageous sum.

What is Raphael planning? Why was he willing to pay such an absurd amount? What awaits Michelle at the end of her perilous journey?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.native: 伯爵令嬢ミシェルの結婚事情
title.romaji: Hakushaku Reijou Misheru no Kekkon Jijou

192091.description:
Michihiko witnesses an incident in a classroom late at night. Since then, the thug Shinji has been hanging around the school area to investigate the incident. A frail honor student and a small-time gangster – two people of very different ages and backgrounds, but when they get to know each other, a strange friendship somehow blossoms, and Shinji’s presence becomes the only comfort for Michihiko’s immature mind and body. This novel depicts the span of nine years from the time they meet.

(Source: Libre, translated)

192092.description:
Because of his foolish way of living, Momota lost both his home and family. Just when he was about to give up on life, a police officer passing by by chance stopped him. Irritated by the officer’s strict sense of justice, Momota throws an absurd demand at the officer Hamauzu: “Sleep with me.” However, Hamauzu, risking everything, saves Momota. From that moment on, Momota vows to live for him… A single-minded love begins to change everything.

(Source: Libre, translated)

192093.description:
Kenji Yachi was laid off from the foreign company where he had worked for nearly 20 years. Now, over 40 years old, he started a part-time job at a bento shop. As he was healing from the shock of being laid off and living peacefully, Haruno suddenly appeared before him. Haruno was an elite who had graduated from an American graduate school and was the younger boss who had coldly informed Yachi of his dismissal. Although Yachi wished to never see him again because it reminded him of the feeling of being declared incompetent, Haruno came to the shop every weekend, bought a bento, and started talking to him. What are his true intentions…?

(Source: Libre, translated)

192094.description:
The Saintess of the kingdom of love was used and discarded by the prince. She is then reincarnated to the time before her engagement, rejecting the prince this time around, only to find him madly in love with her...!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: The Abandoned Saintess' Vow: To Deny the Prince's Love in Her Next Life

192097.description:
At first glance, Yeong-Han seems like an ideal boyfriend, with stellar grades and good looks, but he’s actually infamous for his awful temper. On the other hand, Yae-Joon is mild-mannered and polite, and he loathes people like Yeong-Han. Unfortunately, they have to act as a couple for a college course that assigns pairs to recreate a dating relationship. Yeong-Han is displeased, and Yae-Joon even more so. As the two clash and bicker, they slowly wear down each other’s walls to discover their more vulnerable sides. Will this pretend relationship eventually turn into something more genuine?

(Source: Tappytoon)

192099.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2025 May issue.

192102.description:
After an endless “love affair” with a brave warrior, a legendary weapon, and the demon lord, Seijo, is given a new life as "Kamishiro Hybrid." He becomes a father and feels at peace, but there is his other son, Ushiwakamaru, who is tormented by loneliness. Now that Ushiwakamaru's half-brother has suddenly arrived to take away his place in the world, a “jet-black emotion” starts swirling in his heart, an emotion that no one else can understand. Ushiwakamaru, consumed by the darkness, renounces his morals and declares, "I will create my own kingdom, a Paradise Kingdom..."

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: パラダイスキングダム

192106.description: After his father is laid off, high school student Higurashi Kurage ends up working part-time at a huge mansion. However, the owner of the mansion is Nostradamus, who has become a recluse and hates reality due to the trauma of a past mistaken prediction...? A heartwarming comedy about the strange friendship between the unfortunate handsome Nostradamus and a high school student! Acting in real life!

192107.description: Note: Published in Loli Babaa Senmon Anthology Chiyoko Maki no Ni

192108.description:
Rikka, a working woman, has a young stepbrother Rin, a college student. For over ten years, Rin has secretly harbored feelings for his beautiful and responsible stepsister. He was convinced that she only saw him as a little brother and that he could never confess his feelings… until they end up going out on a “practice date”!? For the first time, he's calling her by her first name, holding hands together… As they act more and more like a real couple, his pent-up love for her is on the verge of bursting!?

(Source: Gangan Online, translated)

title.native: こじれにこじれた義姉弟の話
title.romaji: Kojire ni Kojireta Gikyoudai no Hanashi

Kanae's best friend, Nao, who was supposed to have died in a traffic accident two months ago, appears before her as a ghost, looking exactly the same as when she was alive, and says, "I can't just leave you alone." The two of them go about their daily lives as usual, but Kanae's sense of unease gradually grows as she sees Nao's strong hostility towards anyone who hurts her...

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2025 February issue.

192118.description:
Having lost his memories, Tatsuya eventually rediscovers his true nature and rapes his homeroom teacher, Touko. Having discovered the pleasure of violating a woman, Tatsuya sets out to find his next prey. He decides on Chisato, a friendly and popular gym teacher, as his target. He pretends to help her with her work, approaches her, and succeeds in taking her virginity. He then rapes Shino, the school principal, and Kurumi, a school nurse, and imprints the pleasures of sex on their bodies as well…!

(Source: Paradigm Novels, translated)

title.native: 牝教師３～淫悦の学舎～　千里編
title.romaji: Mesu Kyoushi 3: Inetsu no Gakusha Chisato-hen

192119.description:
When Tatsuya woke up, he had lost his memories. He couldn't even remember his own name, but with the help of his homeroom teacher, Touko, and other teachers, he is able to live his school life without any difficulties. However, when Tatsuya investigates how he lost his memory, he discovers Touko's true intentions. This triggers Tatsuya to give in to his deep-seated lust, and he rapes her. In order to relive the intense arousal and pleasure he felt there, he begins to fuck the other female teachers, Leena and Yurika, as well…

(Source: Paradigm Novels, translated)

title.native: 牝教師３～淫悦の学舎～　灯子編
title.romaji: Mesu Kyoushi 3: Inetsu no Gakusha Touko-hen

192120.description: The high school delinquent Wu Haotian secretly followed his crush Yan Yu to a mysterious temple one day, only to accidentally awaken the power of a jade stone that imbued him with the soul of a mighty Three Kingdoms general. The battle for the 81 Nine-by-Nine Jades has begun.

192121.description:
During an intimate moment, a snake spirit called Soukou asks Shou, a nian monster, to become his life partner. Shou decides he needs to think about it and asks for some time. Meanwhile, a tragedy befalls the nian clan after a long, exhausting history of conflict with humans. As a result, the village decides they need to relocate. Shou visits Soukou to tell him the news, but he can't quite gather the courage to tell him the most vital part. Will the two of them be separated?

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 蛇の伴侶になっておくれ－獣人の約束－

title.english: A Promise -The Snake Spirit and the Nian Monster-

192122.description:
Yu Yang had never thought that there were evil babies in the world. His fate changed because of meeting Zhang Cheng. This person who took care of him in every way turned out to be his greatest enemy in this life. Should he kill him?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

192123.description:
Kaori is in love with her first boyfriend, Azuma.
He always treat her with kindness, trying to make Kaori happy, and she's not sure if she's offering enough in return. Until an incident reveals Azuma's true nature.

(Source: Dessert, translated)

Note: Originally published in Dessert Magazine June 2025 issue's Pink supplemental.

title.native: やきもち焼くならオレンジ色

192125.description:
Chosen by the last remaining Seabird, Lott has been cursed with a target on her back. After the notorious Woohoppiage pirates pillage her village and kidnap her sister, she embarks on a perilous journey to get her back. And she’ll do whatever it takes to make that happen, even if that means joining the Black Ocean crew and pretending to be a man. But she's not the only one with a secret on this pirate ship…

(Source: WEBTOON)

192126.description:
Planet Well is facing an apocalypse when an asteroid hits it in a month and a half, so residents are being relocated. Tigris fails the test to migrate, and is told that she has emotional defects. Manase, a humanoid robot who works as a doctor, suggests that she become friends with her...

The winner of the Comic Yuri-Hime Award at the 5th Yuri Literary Novel Contest has been made into a manga in this volume!

(Source: Ichijinsha Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2024 June issue.

192127.description:
Nachi is a single mother who lost her husband. Raising a child while working is hard, and she has a lot of troubles with her unfamiliar job... But at times like these, her beloved son is always there to protect her!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 君はぼくのヒーローさ
title.romaji: Kimi wa Boku no Hero sa

192128.description:
Without warning, Russian troops suddenly land in Hokkaido. The Self-Defense Forces evacuate the residents and set up defensive positions. As the standoff continues, platoon leader 3rd Lieutenant Adachi receives a call from the company command post on the outskirts of Kushiro. The enemy is preparing to begin combat operations in the morning. Tanks and other armored vehicles are approaching… as the “real battle” begins!

(Source: Bungeishunjuu, translated)

192129.description:
Karin Kasuga is a female police officer who values ​​"protecting the safety of citizens" above all else. Although she is a woman, Karin has always been on the one protecting others since she was little, and she has always longed for a prince charming who would protect her. One day, she is transferred to the female VIP-only SP department, commonly known as QB (Queen's Butler). She is surrounded by handsome men...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: QBかりん 警視庁特殊SP班
ほのかいろづくななかまど

192131.description:
I can't go home at 9 o'clock today either... because I can't stop chatting while working overtime...!! From the conflict between being a girl and an old lady, to the dark tale of being confused about fashion in your late 20s, to a confession that you actually don't know how to apply makeup properly, these are four-panel, carefree ramblings of women in their 30s that are no big deal but are still important!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: I Want to Go to a House at 9

192132.description:
Pleasant human relationships make for a comfortable workplace life! An exhilarating office story.

The most difficult and important thing in the workplace is not to work hard, but to build smooth human relationships. Souko Uehara, also known as Ue-chan, a bossy office lady in the sales department, solves various problems within the company, sometimes sternly, sometimes gently, in a refreshing and heartwarming way. A work story that will make all the workers happy and cheerful!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 魔法少女マジピュア ～NTR調教に堕ちるW魔法少女～THE COMIC
title.romaji: Mahou Shoujo Magi Pure: NTR Choukyou ni Ochiru W Mahou Shoujo THE COMIC

192136.description:
1. Wakare no Serenade (別れのセレナーデ)
2. Amai Noroi (甘い呪い)
3. Nichijou-kei Engiha Joyuu (日常系 演技派女優)
4. Nemureru Ginga (眠れる銀河)
5. Alien Mama (エイリアンママ)
6. Colorful (Colorful)

192137.description:
In the North Forest lives Teddy, a great doll repairman. When humans throw broken dolls into the forest, Catsy, the guardian of the North Forest, collects them and brings them to Teddy. Then, the dolls are repaired beautifully by Teddy, and they either go on a journey to find new owners or choose eternal peace. And some come to life and become residents of the North Forest Full Bloom. One day, a shooting star falls on the always peaceful North Forest, and a box containing a small doll broken into pieces is found along with the remains of the shooting star. A doll that someone has broken so that it can never be repaired. Teddy carefully fixes the doll, and the doll opens its eyes with the name Orange Doll…

(Source: Witch Comics, translated)

192140.description:
After trying to destroy the Jinsik that had been imprisoned for 40 years, he collapses and when he comes to, he finds himself in the body of a young man in his 20s.

"Hahahaha! I've become a master of Banrohwandong... Huh?"

He did get younger... but all the internal energy that he's trained his whole life for has disappeared?! I thought it was Banrohwandong, but it's possession! On top of that, the owner of the body is so frail that even his nickname is "MuMu (無武)". Kang Daesan, the sole successor of the Mugeuk School who lost his internal energy but gained youth, freedom, and a family. There's nothing he can do about it, martial arts skills just need to be recovered. The second son of the Changcheon Confucian School, the frail Yu Seok, begins his exhilarating journey!

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

192141.description:
Deep inside a large castle, in a forgotten palace, there was a "princess". Since a certain incident, no one has approached the place, but one day, a gardener apprentice named Mel arrives. Talking to her becomes part of the "princess's" daily routine...

(Source: Ichijinsha Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime December 2023 issue.

title.native: 私の小さなおひめさま

192142.description:
Zoe was sent to the "Remaining Island" as a sacrifice to the dragon. However, the dragon was long gone, and Zoe was trying to return to her homeland with the help of a girl named Leila whom she met on the island. Then, on the day of her departure, Zoe collapses...

(Source: Ichijinsha Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime April 2024 issue.

192143.description:
Childhood friends Koma and Yura have made a promise to meet every Thursday after school. After visiting a suspicious personal website, Yura gleefully proclaims that "the world will end in a year," while Koma tells her not to change.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime April 2024 issue.

192146.description: "Sea God Jang Bogo," tells the story of Jang Bogo, who opened a small sea route, learned wisdom from the sea, and developed a grand worldview. Jang Bogo was born in Wando during the Unified Silla period and showed outstanding ability in archery from a young age. He was also called "Gungbok" because he was "good at archery." Feeling skeptical about Silla's bone rank system that discriminated against social status, he went to Tang to realize his grand dream.

192147.description:
Meme and Tomochi are good friends and always together, so they even spent New Year's together. But then Meme accidentally chokes on a rice cake...? A high-tension romantic comedy that starts with "mochi"!!

(Source: Ichijinsha Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2024 May issue.

title.romaji: Haha no Milk, Ore no Shiru.

192152.description:
I chose the thing I could do right away to pay off my debt, and for me it was sales. And then I was given another chance

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: I Became a Genius in Sales
営業の天才～そのカーディーラーは二度生きる～

192153.description:
Hayool was supposed to be a genius mage and the next head of his clan, but when he turns out to be incompatible with magical AI, his friends and family expect him to give up on his dreams. Too determined to abandon his ambitions, he discovers a book written by the founder of magic itself, and it teaches him to do magic without AI. Suddenly much more powerful than his classmates and school bullies, it seems he might have a bright future after all—if he can survive the secret plots against him.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Return of the Mythical Archmage
レイベル・ヴァイテナーの魔導継承
神话级大魔法师的归来

192155.description:
Fully inserted. ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Weekly Kairakutan 2024 No.48

title.native: 姫川さんはデートしたい!

192156.description:
Natasha, a sharp divorce lawyer in an empire where divorce is gradually losing its stigma, thrives on high-paying cases. Driven by her love of money, she's ready to tackle any challenge—whether it's freeing clients from infidelity or helping them escape their fate in a doomed romance fantasy novel. With her assistant Ivan by her side, Natasha navigates the complex, secretive lives of nobles, uncovering hidden truths and securing divorces while always standing firmly by her clients' side.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 離婚はプロにお任せください

title.english: Leave Your Divorce to a Professional Lawyer

192157.description:
1-2. Daidaidaidaidaisuki na Kimi ni Dakaretai kara. (大大大大大好きな君に抱かれたいから。)
3. Nichiyoubi no Cider (日曜日のサイダー)
4. Nureru (ぬれる)
5. Anoyo de Batsu wo (あの世で罰を)
6. Shoka no Haru (初夏の春)

title.native: 大大大大大好きな君に抱かれたいから。
title.romaji: Daidaidaidaidaisuki na Kimi ni Dakaretai kara.

192158.description:
Li Haoran, once a brave youth who fell to his teammates’ betrayal in a brutal battle against strange beasts, awakens to a shocking new life, reborn as Blood Demon King in a hidden village teeming with alluring succubi. Gifted with a twisted system that fuels his power through building a vast harem, Haoran vows to seize this second chance. He will forge himself into an unstoppable demon lord, gather his bewitching companions, and lead his harem to conquer the entire world.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: I Conquered the World With My Harem

title.english: I Rely On My Harem To Conquer The World

192159.description:
After transmigrating into a new world, I end up with a tiny Snowball as my Pet Beast. Everyone laughs, calling it the weakest of the weak—an evolution dead end. A nobody with a useless companion… is that really my fate? Ding! The system activates. I can now see the hidden evolution paths of all Pet Beasts. Weak, you say? Watch closely how my little Snowball is about to evolve and awaken as the Ice Queen.

(Source: WebComics)

Beast Taming: I Can See the Evolution Paths

192162.description:
Spells, Taoist magic, and big swords, other people use three magic weapons to catch monsters and demons, but I, Lu Ziye, raise a bunch of evil gods to catch monsters and demons. A mysterious research institute, imprisoned evil gods, studied evil spirits, Lu Ziye woke up from the mystery. Facing the hostility of evil spirits and endless strange events, in order to survive, Lu Ziye must become stronger. By chance, Lu Ziye met Xiao Huan, a zombie girl with a coffin, and Lu Ziye's road to becoming stronger quietly...

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: 傩神方相（我有一座怪物研究所）
Because I am destined to be in love

title.romaji: Yoru wo Wataru Tsuki no Fune

192166.description:
Tokyo, the 10th year of the Taisho period (1921). Fuki, a 24-year-old maid working at the manor house of the distinguished Tachibana family, is reunited with their son Yugo, who has returned home to enroll at The First Imperial University. With Fuki’s engagement having been dissolved and Yugo having been charged with finding himself a suitable wife, she accepts his proposal of marriage. In an era when parents’ consent is necessary for marriage, and despite the gap between the two in both age and social standing, the admirable maid and elite student’s married life is about to begin.

(Source: K MANGA)
synonyms: O nobre Estudante e sua Cinderela

title.english: The Noble Student and His Cinderella

192167.description:
Solitude nurtures talent... Sadaharu, a high school student, lived a cautious academic life, admiring and aspiring to become like the great historical figures. But then, someone appears who threatens to disrupt his carefully ordered world...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

192168.description:
"Curse me all you want if it feels this good!"

A sinful secret love between two who are unable to repent! Vio accidentally spent a night with a witch and ended up cursed. He seeks help from the saint of the church, Arelka, to break the curse but she rejects him and belittles his lower half as trash. Later, Vio attends a masked ball where he meets a mysterious and beautiful man. Their eyes meet and seem to say, "You're going to entertain me, aren't you?" Never having been interested in men before, he finds himself surprisingly drawn to the man's seductive and innocent reactions. The next morning...

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Whispers of Love With an Immoral Saint
title.native: ふしだら聖者と睦言を。

192169.description:
The manga centers on Leon, the magic sword user who defeated the demon lord. He decided to move with the changing times, and elects to leave the hero's party in order to study the new ways of magic at one of the kingdom's seven magic academies.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 強すぎて勇者パーティーを卒業した最強剣士、魔法学園でも愛される
title.romaji: Tsuyo Sugite Yuusha Party wo Sotsugyou shita Saikyou Kenshi, Mahou Gakuen demo Aisareru

192171.description:
Toya Sakurai is swimming in success after his work with the bestselling author Kai Hodaka, who is also Toya’s secret lover. But with expectations so high, his company soon gives him a new project: find a fresh and exciting new author to work for Sozan Publishing. When Toya finds the young author Yo Amano, he discovers that the traits his lover Hodaka lacks, Amano has, and Amano is sensitive and caring to Toya's feelings. Emotions will run high in this second volume of The Guilty series.

(Source: Digital Manga Publishing)

Note: Originally published by Movic in September 2002, was then re-released by Frontier Works under Daria Bunko in August 2005 with an additional short story.

192172.description:
Editor Toya Sakurai is the talk of the industry for his amazing work with best-selling mystery writer Kai Hodaka. But most people don’t know that the root of Toya’s success is his secret relationship with Hodaka. However, Toya’s success leads to jealousy from his coworkers, and that jealousy fuels some hateful gossip. All of this compounds when rumors fly around the internet about Hodaka having a relationship with one of his male editors. When Toya tries to distance himself from Hodaka to abate the rumors, everything gets worse, until finally, Hodaka asks for a new editor! Can these two guilty hearts find happiness together?

(Source: Digital Manga Publishing)

Note: Originally published in November 2003, was then re-released in November 2005 with an additional short story.

192173.description:
Toya Sakurai is starting fresh in a new apartment, now enticingly closer to his lover, Kai Hodaka. When he invites his lover to come visit, he realizes the benefits of living so much closer. But when Toya’s publishing company decides to put out a fan book on Kai Hodaka, Toya is shocked to learn just how little he knows about his lover after two years! Also includes a collection of short stories with deeper insight on our favorite guilty pair! Toya spends a love burning weekend with Hodaka in Hayama after the torturously written Emergence. Then, six months into their riotous relationship, Hodaka shows just what he’s willing to do to make Toya happy. The loving, dangerous, guilty love they share comes to a climax in this final volume.

(Source: Digital Manga Publishing)

Note: Originally published in October 2004, was then re-released in August 2006 with an additional short story.

192174.description:
Debut work of Yumiko Ooshima

Note: originally published in Margaret 1968 Special Spring issue, it was later reprinted in Ribon DX 1976 Spring issue.

192175.description:
Katsuya just got something special that Hiroyuki cannot believe! Katsuya shows off a magical ring, and when he slips in on, his body takes on the shape of his most ideal girl. Amazed by the transformation, Hiroyuki puts the ring on and feels his body transforming, but as he continues changing, his mind is also forgetting his former self. Now they have fallen into Katsuya's trap…

(Source: Fakku!)

192176.description: It's a giantess comedy about a little sister who gets bigger.

title.native: ジャイアントリトルシスター

192184.description:
Rowan glimpses a dark future just ten years away. Unfortunately, he’s no powerful leader—just an orphan with an incredible talent for magic. Luckily, his potential won’t stay hidden forever. He joins Union Academy, which is filled with potential partners in the fight against dark magic… if only his teachers and classmates could understand magic theory on his level. But if Rowan can keep everyone focused, they might just stop their world from going up in flames.

(Source: Tapas)

192188.description:
“I’m baaaaaaaaaack!!!”

Six years ago, Yura Natsuki was summoned to another world as a hero. Drawn into the war between humans and demons, he was told the typical trope—to return to his world, he had to defeat the Demon King. He fought desperately, siding with the humans who ruthlessly cast aside even their own kind, used as a pawn, and forced into a horrific war—all because he desperately wanted to survive.

He finally managed to return to Earth, only to encounter even more fantastical elements than another world—gods, angels, and aliens!?

"Earth is pretty fantastical, huh?"

title.native: 異世界から帰還したら地球もかなりファンタジーでした。あと、負けヒロインどもこっち見んな。

Kousuke sprains his hand catching Saaya. It's time for Mommy to take care of him! After a tasty meal, it's time for dessert. Wouldn't it be wonderful if they could do this every day?

192200.description:
Aki Hoshino is interested in "Ichinose-san" who works at the bookstore where she works part-time. Ichinose-san, whose trademark is a turtleneck that hides her skin, is cool and mysterious...

(Source: Ichijinsha Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime August 2023 issue.

192201.description:
Recently, a mysterious "strange radio wave" has been affecting communications on Earth. When researcher Fron traces the source of the wave, she finds Shano, an alien who has made an emergency landing on Earth. Shano seems to be having trouble repairing her spaceship.

(Source: Ichijinsha Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime July 2023 issue.

192202.description:
Even after the master of the house where she worked passed away, Yori, a servant, continued to take care of Coco, the android "Lady," left behind by him...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime July 2023 issue.

192203.description:
Nagi, a college student, has been in love with Yuko, who has been a good friend of hers since high school. However, Yuko, who can't hide anything, one day shows up wearing a ring and tells her she has a boyfriend...

(Source: Ichijinsha Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2023 July issue.

The Person I Love Puts A Ring On My Finger

192204.description:
Kazuya is allowing his junior colleague, Mika, to stay in his place in exchange for taking care of the housework. Mika is grateful for the arrangement but quickly learns his senior has a peculiar trait: he hates taking baths! Can Mika manage to get everything–and everyone—squeaky clean, or will this arrangement turn into a mess?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Will You Take a Bath With Me?
title.native: グッドナイト・ルーティン

192205.description:
Welcome to the popular café where cute penguins and handsome guys are working!

One day, a college boy brings a "new part-time job" to the cafe. This is "CAFE MICHIKAKE", a popular cafe where penguins of various personalities work. We will heal you with cuteness and laughter. They work, get depressed, get angry because they eat too much, and are very busy today!

This is a heartwarming daily life story that will surely make you laugh and be healed by the handsome men who are pushed around by the penguins who are full of cuteness.

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Kadokawa for serialization.
synonyms: The Sky Over Penguin Cafe Is Still Blue

title.romaji: Penguin Kissa wa Kyo mo Seiten

192206.description:
After transferring to a glamorous girls' school, Ikeda Rio meets the most glamorous student council president and vice-president duo in the school. However, the two of them have a secret...

(Source: Ichijinsha Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime October 2023 issue.

title.native: エクストリームスーパーダーリン

192207.description:
Maho, an office worker, enjoys a simple pleasure in reading books at the library until closing time. One day, she meets a high school student who is crying while reading her favorite book, and before she knows it, they have been writing to each other every day...

(Source: Ichijinsha Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime June 2023 issue.
synonyms: See You Tomorrow, At The Usual Place.

title.native: ぬくぬく母ちゃん!増補改訂版

192210.description:
Setchan is in love with her beautiful cousin Sumire. One day, after meeting Sumire for the first time in a long time, they decide to swap uniforms and wear them together...

(Source: Ichijinsha Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime June 2023 issue.

192212.description:
Itsuki and Hidaka, second-year high school students, just started dating and have yet to do anything romantic. Hidaka finds the "list of things I want to do if we date" that Itsuki has been keeping a secret. Despite Itsuki's insecurity, Hitaka is eager to give it a shot...!?

(Source: LEED, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ときめく僕らのねがいごと

192213.description:
Struggling sisters Niina and Mana receive a birthday present from their father. But who would have thought they'd end up winning a 300-million-yen jackpot?! With their newfound fortune, these girls strive to live the high life their own way, in this heartfelt financial comedy!

(Source: Manga UP!)

192214.description:
Riku started working for an event management company after he became mesmerized by Kaito, a member of an idol group called "FIFTH." When Riku is put in charge of managing a FIFTH concert, the group's manager acknowledges his work and asks him to become an assistant manager. When he is about to accept the offer, he is told that the company has a strict policy of not hiring fans. He ends up taking the job while hiding the fact that he's a total Kaito fanboy. Constantly afraid of being outed as a fan and fired, one day, Riku is asked to wake up Kaito in his hotel room. The excitement of waking up his fave and his professionalism battling each other, he heads to the hotel room... and oh my! His fave dressed only in his bathrobe greets him at the door. While Riku stands there stunned by his fave's beautiful face and this unusual situation, Kaito suddenly kisses him... and asks for more...?! No matter how physically close he gets to his fave, Riku must not cross the line as a manager.

A forbidden love between an idol with a picture-perfect face and a plain manager who's secretly a fanboy!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: 他人に言えない推しゴト事情

title.english: My Top-Secret Work Romance With My Fave
title.native: 他人(ヒト)に言えない推しゴト事情

synonyms: The Secret Hidden By This Elite School's Morals Committee

title.native: 超エリート高校に隠された風紀委員制度　ありえない学園の特権とご褒美
title.romaji: Chou Elite Koukou ni Kakusareta Fuuki Iin Seido Arienai Gakuen no Tokken to Gohoubi

192216.description:
Seong-Min, who works at Regis, feels eyes watching him in an alleyway one day. However, he is unable to confirm the identity, and the next day he goes to serve at a private room. There, Seong-Min feels similar eyes watching him in the alleyway. That night, while on his way home from work, Seong-Min is being chased by a stalker and meets Yu-Won again. Yu-wWon pretends to recognize Seong-Min and is happy to see him. Seong-Min is flustered by this sudden reunion with Yu-Won, but he also sleeps at his house to avoid the stalker. However, his behavior is somehow strange.

“… Wait, did I ever tell you my home address?”

Yu-Won carries out one scheme after another to tie up Seong-Min’s body and mind.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

192217.description:
Jun is a mommy-hunter who pretends to be a real mom. Tonight's partner, Makoto, is a company president who seems to have a lot of experience, and she's excited. However, there's something strange about Makoto...

(Source: Ichijinsha Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime May 2023 issue.
synonyms: Cat Isn't Ready For Kiss Yet

title.romaji: Neko ni Kisu wa Mada Hayai

192218.description:
Azuki, a girl with the power to heal curses, spends her days having curses lifted for the sake of arrogant nobles. One day, she is ordered to lift the curse of the lord, Suna. At first, Azuki is frightened, but...

(Source: Ichijinsha Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime May 2023 issue.
synonyms: Azusa Moon Blooms in the Sky

192219.description:
Today is the one-year anniversary of when I started dating my girlfriend. We were supposed to celebrate by dressing up and going to a restaurant, but in front of me was her in her loungewear and a plate of soft-boiled eggs with mayonnaise and egg toast, which I hate...

(Source: Ichijinsha Plus, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime April 2023 issue.

192220.description:
The F12 Center is infamous for one thing—its dangerously high superhuman burnout rate. And that’s exactly where civilian diagnostics officer Baek Shi-Jin is suddenly transferred. On his first day, Shi-Jin is approached by Jeong Tae-Yool, an A-rank Guide with a reputation as sharp as his instincts, under the guise of an admin worker.

“Just stop giving Ham Geon-Woo your attention, and we’ll get along fine.”

Shi-Jin only wanted to repay Ham Geon-Woo, the Esper who saved him a decade ago. But somehow, his highest match rate is with Tae-Yool—who sees right through him.

"Doc, are you really using seduction to request a scan?”

From then on, Tae-Yool seems to appear everywhere—especially when Shi-Jin’s in danger.

“If this were a real emergency, Alpha Team would be here to protect you in under 60 seconds.”

What kind of ending awaits a sharp-eyed Superhuman and a guarded civilian doctor?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: テソロ・オブ・ザ・ガイド

192221.description:
After the fall of his noble family, Damon drifts from place to place until he hears of an open position as a private tutor for a sheltered young heir named Eden. From their very first meeting, Eden blushes easily and wears his emotions openly, a lonely young master who seems far too easy to manipulate. Damon convinces himself that if he plays his cards right, he can settle here comfortably for the rest of his life. But life in the mansion takes a turn Damon never expected, and he begins to suspect that his arrival was part of a carefully laid trap.

As Eden longs for beauty and Damon clings to what never changes, the walls of the mansion close in, and the truth behind their bond slowly comes to light.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 自己責任〜肉欲に堕ちる女たち〜

192223.description:
Ha-Min was the quiet, chubby kid with a hopeless crush on his friend’s older brother. Years later in college, he's slimmed down and unrecognizable. When Tae-Rim starts treating him with the same gentle warmth as before, Ha-Min finds his feelings rushing back.

(Source: Manta)

title.native: もう笑顔でうつれない

だいすき! いとしのムーコ

192228.description:
The story centers on Materi, a high school girl who is suddenly summoned to a kingdom in another world, with a supposedly powerful skill in her. But the kingdom's ruler deems Materi's "Clear Reward" skill useless, and exiles her, thus activating her skill. As it turns out, Materi can gather rare weapons and useful items just by clearing the trials given to her. Materi becomes obsessed with acquiring skills and gathering items.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: どうも、物欲の聖女です～無双スキル「クリア報酬」で盛大に勘違いされました～
title.romaji: Doumo, Butsuyoku no Seijo desu: Musou Skill [Clear Houshuu] de Seidai ni Kanchigai Saremashita

192229.description:
Fuu, Enjoji, Rio, and Mizuho. They were classmates in middle school, and now they're mothers. Okuzono-san and Fuu's only daughter, Nori, is in her first year of middle school. The classmates (and seniors) she met in the drama club are the daughters of Enjoji, Rio, and Mizuho, ​​respectively... A story of lost Alices that transcends generations!

(Source: Kiss, translated)

title.native: 彼女のディルド僕のオナホ
title.romaji: Kanojo no Dildo Boku no Onaho

192232.description:
"You say 'Nice to meet you' to the person who has passed away and then say 'Goodbye' right away. The job of a funeral director is to give the best 'goodbye' possible in the limited time available." Tamako, who has a crush on Kishigawa-kun, goes to his family's house out of her feelings for him, and is introduced to the dramatic world of funerals...!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Nice to Meet You and Say Goodbye

ロリータ・コンプレックス

title.romaji: Shi ni Midori Tensei Shoujo to Unmei no Koi

192238.description: Note: A live-action AV adaptation (MIMK-094) was released on September 7th, 2021

192239.description:
As we all know, you can level up by killing monsters, and I am... that monster. As the only zombie on earth that can turn around and not die, I concealed my identity and kept a low profile as a zombie in order to protect myself. However, I was worried about my sick ex-girlfriend, so I secretly protected her. I didn't expect that my ex-girlfriend had become a female warrior who killed zombies without blinking an eye, and I was discovered by her? I wanted to escape, she wanted to chase me, we struggled and fell in love, and in the end you told me that the whole world had to die? Okay, I won't pretend anymore, I am actually a vaccine.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Dalao Ni Tou You Diao Le

192240.description:
The Ichijo family stands atop the nine families, all of whom possess supernatural powers that protect the land. Riko Momose was born into a powerful branch, but during the foresight ritual meant to determine her abilities, it was discovered she had absolutely none. From that moment on, she was mistreated by her parents and her younger sister. Riko's power eventually awakens, but in order to live a peaceful life, she keeps it a secret. During the spring of her 17th year, Ren, the next head of the Ichijo family, becomes her teacher and notices her powers. Intrigued, he quickly approaches Riko, but...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Powerless Yet Bonded to the Family's Next Heir
title.native: 無能力の私が次期当主のツガイになりました
title.romaji: Munou Ryoku no Watashi ga Jiki Toushu no Tsugai ni Narimashita

192242.description: Note: Published in Hitozuma Kairaku Ikikurui (人妻快楽イキ狂い).

title.romaji: Uchi no Hahaoya ga Moto AV Joyuu Datta Ken

title.native: ど底辺令嬢に憑依した800年前の悪女はひっそり青春を楽しんでいる。
title.romaji: Do Teihen Rejou ni Hyoui Shita 800-nen Mae no Akujo wa Hissori Seishun wo Tanoshindeiru.

192244.description: Note: Published in Tsuyoki na Motoyan demo Ecchi wa Yowayowa!? "Ki, Kimochi Yoku nanka Nee.. zo" (強気な元ヤンでもエッチはよわよわ！？「き、気持ちよくなんかね〜…ぞっ」)

title.native: ど底辺令嬢に憑依した800年前の悪女はひっそり青春を楽しんでいる。
title.romaji: Do Teihen Rejou ni Hyoui Shita 800-nen Mae no Akujo wa Hissori Seishun wo Tanoshindeiru.

192246.description:
Korea’s top star. Actress Seo Sa-Ra.

"What do you think I've improved the most in my ten years as an actress?"
"Hmm… my acting?"
"Nope. My patience and mental illness."

After surviving ten years in the entertainment industry, she thought she'd been through everything. But then—

"I’m Yoon Seung-tae."

A capable and handsome third-generation chaebol shows up with an unexpected offer!

"Can we meet again next time?"
"That sounds almost like a threat. I’m misunderstanding, right?"
"It’s just a proposal. Something mutually beneficial."

A man trying to cast Sa-Ra into his own life.

"You’re like a real Cinderella. You left behind your earring, just like the glass slipper. I may not be a prince, but I’m looking for the Cinderella who left this behind."

The genre of the story he’s plotting is—

"Good thing, I guess. Anyone with pierced ears can wear them, after all."

Is this really a romantic comedy…?

192247.description:
Eun-Ha likes flirting with Woo-Geon at the office, but she knows their relationship can never be more than that. After all, he’s the heir to the huge conglomerate that owns the company they work for, while she’s nothing but an unwanted, illegitimate child. But when Woo-Geon catches Eun-Ha in an awkward position outside of the office, secrets and misunderstandings lead to Woo-Geon making an offer that is definitely “not safe for work”...

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Irregular Company Relationships in the Workplace

title.native: みるきぃコントロール

synonyms: I'm Gonna Fuck This Little Girl as I Please

title.native: あの子にヤリたい事をヤる
title.romaji: Anoko ni Yaritai Koto wo Yaru

title.native: つるまん飯店へようこそ！？

192251.description:
The singer trainee Pyeong-Hwa who appeared in front of U-Ju, a boy who had lost interest in his twisted life, was more than anything a fun, exciting, and shining being. U-Ju, who thought it was enough to just watch Pyeong-Hwa debut from the side, soon came to have a goal of standing next to him. He began to develop precious feelings for Pyeong-Hwa who approached him without hesitation, and those feelings built up and built up, eventually becoming a greed called 'love'.

'I wish you would never know my heart. But I wish you knew.'

But he knows. That it shouldn't be like that. He doesn't want to be a nuisance to Pyeong-Hwa who said he would not date before or after his debut. So how is Pyeong-Hwa's heart moving now? As he learns about the sweat and tears hidden behind the splendid stage, and the other side of the world he thought was only beautiful, U-Ju cannot leave Pyeong-Hwa's side.

A love story between boys with many wounds.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: 君のために練習生になりました

192252.description:
Hoping to get rich, Eun-Je signs a contract for a high-paying tutoring gig, thinking she just hit the jackpot. Expecting to find a cute middle schooler, she's shocked to discover she'll be tutoring her former classmate and man of her nightmares, Soo-In! With his harsh way of speaking and rough manners, she is doubly surprised to find that when they're alone, he's not so bad. Will Eun-Je get to teach some simple math in peace, or will Soo-In's hidden soft side give her a quick lesson in love instead?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.
synonyms: この恋、全力で回避します！

title.english: Flee if You Can't Avoid It

192253.description:
"Welcome to Another World. Exciting adventures with millions of other users await you!"

Or at least, that's what Jiseok was promised when logging in. Instead, he finds himself alone with nothing but an ordinary shovel to fend off ferocious beasts, evil dragons, and... some dude in tighty-whities? Now, Jiseok's only got two choices - dig or die.

(Source: WEBTOON)

192254.description:
Kim Ga-Bi, a college student who suddenly becomes a building owner. Lee Ji-Eul, the man who changed her fate and disappeared. Ji-Eul reappears in Ga-Bi's building. Just like the first time, one day... suddenly.

(Source: Naver, translated)

192255.description:
In the Cakeverse world, secondary traits are managed just like family registers. There are "Forks" who latently lose their sense of taste, and "Cakes" who are innately delicious-tasting humans. "Cakes" and "Forks" are bound by contract as partners who provide bodily fluids. Andou, a "Cake" who works at the city hall, meets Sabitsugu, a "Fork", through his job. Andou suddenly feels his heart beat faster at a piercing gaze that seems to devour him, while Sabitsugu locks onto his delicious cake constitution and waits for him after work, day after day, as if courting him. Being pressed, and despite his refusals, Andou could no longer resist this persistent and earnest junior...?!

(Source: Overlap, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.
synonyms: Anything More Than Licking Is Out of the Contract

title.native: 舐める以上は契約外なので!
title.romaji: Nameru Ijou wa Keiyakugai na node!

192256.description:
Corporate worker Yoshinaga Mikiya and programmer Yamaguchi Shunnosuke are together in a so-called same-sex marriage. Their daily life consists of everyday activities like sharing meals and going shopping, yet they find profound happiness in such an ordinary routine. This is what happiness looks like for two married men living together.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: As Long as You're Next to Me

title.native: となりに君がいるなら
title.romaji: Tonari ni Kimi ga Iru nara

192257.description:
The story takes place in the midst of the Greater East Asia War. Rokurou Atsutani is assigned to Rabaul Air Base, a fortress on the front lines feared as an impregnable stronghold of the air corps. There, he meets Wataru Kotohira, the Five Stars of Rabaul. Though an exceptionally skilled pilot, Wataru's constant brawling and troublesome behavior have made him difficult for his superiors to handle. Rokurou is assigned to partner with him aboard the Gekko night fighter. As they live and fight together, Rokurou gradually comes to understand Wataru's kindness and the feelings he keeps hidden, and finds himself drawn to him...

"Will you die with me... up there in the sky?"

With the shadow of defeat drawing ever closer, the two struggle to survive amid the brutal realities of war.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

192258.description:
"A slave who knows things only a noble would…Who is this girl, really?"

Lilliette, once the Empress of the vast Pardinas Empire, was killed by her lover and found herself reincarnated in the body of a nameless slave girl, roughly 17 years in the past. Choosing death over a life of pain, Lilliette provokes a noble and collapses. When she opens her eyes again, standing before her is none other than Slarhan Bentiac, her greatest political rival in her previous life. Now bound as a slave to the same capable man he was then, Lilliette begins a strange new life.

But… why is this man unexpectedly kind and considerate to me?

Determined, Lilliette resolves to use the knowledge from her past to help Slarhan become king for the sake of the empire and to take revenge on the lover who betrayed and killed her: Clid.

(Source: Naver, translated)

192259.description:
Vivian, the daughter of Duke Karlsruhe, uses her influence to have her lover, the illegitimate fifth prince Alex, crowned emperor. But happiness soon turns to despair when Alex takes a mistress and has Vivian imprisoned. Driven to hopelessness, Vivian ends her life—only to awaken on the day of her wedding to Alex, this time with a burning thirst for revenge.

(Source: Manta)

192260.description:
Haruto, a university student, has been harboring a one-sided love for his childhood friend Tsubasa. Tsubasa, a popular guy admired by girls and working as a fashion model, has always prioritized Haruto above anyone else. But now, their time together might be running out... In just six months, Tsubasa will be leaving the dorm to live on his own. Feeling increasingly lonely, Haruto ends up talking to Tsubasa about a confession he received from a junior student...

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Focal Length to my First Love

192262.description:
Hira, a complete newcomer with zero professional credits to his name—and still an active university student—is set to hold a solo photography exhibition?! Presented with an unprecedented opportunity, Hira finds himself turning to… a unique kind of meditation to avoid his swelling anxiety. Meanwhile, his boyfriend Kiyoi watches on with deep concern, but for once he finds himself unable to offer any advice to Hira—the very man who worships him as a god. If he’s going to fall into a man’s arms, he figures, he might as well choose the better-looking one.

The secret romance between the crown prince Do-ha, who hides his identity, and the fallen noble Eun-Rin, blossoms in the deepest part of the palace.

A strange letter suddenly appears.

[If you don't want to die like this, accept it.]

Of course I don't want to die! Rowena accepts the mysterious offer and... goes back 3 years. That's how the regression began. If you want to live and see the future, you have no choice but to keep dying and regressing to get clues and move forward! Will Rowena be able to overcome all the dead endings and reach the best ending?

However, after that meeting, suspicious circumstances between her lover and her friend begin to be detected, and Yu-Ju tries to resolve the suspicions, but the two only point fingers at each other and give conflicting explanations…

Whose words are the truth, and whose fault is it? The truth that she finally witnesses ends up placing the responsibility on Yu-Ju. In front of the broken Yu-Ju, there is a female protagonist in the same situation as Yu-Ju on the screen. Women in the media who become pretty, take revenge, meet a better man, and eventually escape from their wounds forever and live a new life. If Yu-Ju does like them, will she be able to return to her happy self? Or is it all just a naive wish?

192328.description:
The book, based on writings by the psychiatrist Yuki Yu, explains why people who die of overwork or commit suicide from work stress cannot "just quit.” It shows how people become trapped in their jobs and can't escape even at the cost of their own lives. The book also describes methods and ways of thinking that can help people who are consumed by work. The book also includes “I got out of a dark place,” a collection of interviews with people who have escaped from overwork depression and found happiness.

We don't want to any more incidents of death by overwork and suicide.
This book is a must-read for everyone working in modern Japan.

192345.description:
Pilot Ji Yoon-Woo has a passionate lover, Choi Jun-Won, who is four years younger than him. One day, waiting for Yoon-Woo when he returned home after finishing a flight was Jun-Won, who had unexpectedly turned out to be a kidnapper. “Don’t move.” A low, deep voice whispered earnestly in his ear. “Co-pilot Ji Yoon-Woo, you’d better stay still.” The voice he wanted to hear more than anyone else. That familiar voice threatened with unfamiliar words.

“How does it feel to be searched so deep inside?”
“Haa, ha. Stop…”
“It’s not confirmed yet, so please cooperate, Captain.”

A sweet and energetic sex play between Co-pilot Ji Yoon-Woo and Choi Jun-Won, an airport counter-terrorism task force police officer.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.

192348.description:
Hye-Ri, a reviewer who is famous for her reviews of all kinds of sex toys, is a 29-year virgin who has never held a man's hand.

"I wish I had a real, living boyfriend who I'm compatible with, not an electronic boyfriend who I'm compatible with!"

The heavens were moved by her tearful sincerity, and Hye-Ri ends up dating two handsome men in one day...

Wait, I didn't ask her to date me like this(?)!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

192349.description:
Carefree chaebol Seo-Hee Lee agrees to marry her university acquaintance Seung-Hyun Chae in a strategic marriage—only to realize too late that his mother is the stuff of nightmares for a daughter-in-law. Can Seo-Hee survive her toughest challenge yet and perhaps even find true love?

(Source: Manta)

192350.description:
Jang Jin-Myeong, a master of Gyuhwabojeon. He is accused of being a traitor and falls off a cliff right before he dies. He realizes his two mistakes. One is that he read the secret Gyuhwabojeon, which gives you strength but loses your masculinity, and the other is that he did not kill those cowards, Wang Jin and Seop Pyeong, earlier. When he opens his eyes in an unknown space when he is about to die, he sees the real Gyuhwabojeon and regresses to 32 years ago, just before he was castrated. Fortunately, in his second life, Jin-Myeong protects his belongings, and the power of Gyuhwabojeon still remains in his body!!!

Jin-Myeong decides to go back to the choice he regretted in his past life and take revenge on Wang Jin and Seop Pyeong who drove him to death.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.romaji: Ishida Mitsunari no Tsuma wa Taihen

192353.description:
“Sorcerer“...an accursed name given to the most feared heretics known to the world. Roan, one such sorcerer, lives a life worse than slavery, one forced upon him by a circus troupe. Things only change when he runs into Kito, a fellow sorcerer and a member of the Nightbells, a notorious vigilante group. It won't be much longer before these most hated of people are the very ones tasked with saving the world, in this magical fantasy exploding with style!

(Source: K Manga)

192354.description: The darkness of vampires corrodes the entertainment industry. A "real" light tears through that darkness - the Animate Theater, located underground in Ikebukuro, Tokyo. Here, the first solo live performance of "Banflame", the idol group to which the main character, Chishoko, belongs, is taking place. Ko is chatting away as usual, but something strange happens in the middle of the concert!?

192357.description:
Dr. Cha Soo-Hyuk is a pediatric trauma surgeon who grew up in America after being adopted. Now he's back in Korea in search of his birth parents, but from the nosy strangers to the spicy food, he's having a really tough time! Then one day, he runs into Lee Yoo-Na, the owner of "Mouthwatering Meals" who has a fear of men. In an attempt to overcome her trauma, she cooks for him, and her food matches his tastes perfectly. Now, he only eats what she cooks for him, for all three meals of the day!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Both R15 and R19 versions are the same up to chapter 39.
