192358.description:
Min-Gyu, a pure-hearted man who has quietly loved his childhood friend Ji-Woo for longer than anyone else. Every time Ji-Woo laughs, grumbles, and approaches him nonchalantly, Min-Gyu's heart grows deeper little by little, but steadily. The problem is that the men Ji-Woo has been crazy about so far are always 'muscular beasts' who are the complete opposite of him. Fortunately, in reality, she has never given her heart to anyone, so Min-Gyu has stayed by her side, even if it means being her boyfriend. However, one peaceful autumn, his hopes are shattered.

"Min-Gyu... I think I've fallen in love."

Ji-Woo suddenly falls in love with Kang Tae-Min, the captain of the volleyball team! Min-Gyu feels the crisis of his life when he realizes that she might 'really' like someone for the first time. In order to protect Ji-Woo from Tae-Min, he tries to become the man that fits her ideal type...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

192359.description:
Mo-Ah, the daughter of a fresh fruit shaved ice shop, who always helps her father's shop every summer. She thought this summer would go by like any other— but the moment she sees the new part-timer her father brought in, all her expectations melt away like shaved ice.

"You work here too, sister? You're awesome!"

A playful voice, a face with a sly smile. The troublesome delinquent Park Si-Heon that she bumped into on the last day of school was right in front of her! The guy she hoped to never see again came in as a part-timer this summer. The two people who had a shaky start clashing every day at the shop—

words colder than shaved ice and emotions hotter than the sun start to mix in the shop.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

192360.description:
Tae-Ju, the youngest son of the GG Group, a conglomerate with a long history. Living in a family that forces crazyness, he is called 'the epitome of crazy and in fact loves cute dolls and sweet desserts. However, such a shameful taste is a secret that he must take to the grave! As the day approaches when he will represent the family, he knows better than anyone that he will have to put it all down someday. Tae-Ju, who consoles himself that this is really the last time, hires a new secretary, Eun-Na, under the pretense of researching a new business, and urges her to accompany him on his dessert cafe tour disguised as work. However, Eun-Na begins to misunderstand his actions in a completely different way...

A boss who hides his taste, and a secretary who has misunderstandings. A strange tension begins to flow between the two!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

192361.description:
Hae-Young is a perfect career woman at work, but lives the life of a thoroughly hidden otaku after work. Her peaceful double life begins to shake due to a handsome cosplayer she encounters at a weekend game event. The identity of the flashy cosplayer is Ju-Yeon, a nerd who is always quiet and inconspicuous at work! The two who have never exchanged a single word with each other end up sharing a secret against their will, and Ju-Yeon makes an unexpected offer to Hae-Young, who asks her not to reveal it at work...

Will this relationship be safe until the end?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

192362.description:
Ho-Seok is a tiger who wants to make and sell cute desserts in peace. While he was once a member of a shady syndicate, he makes the decision to wash his hands of that life and instead follow his dream of opening his own dessert shop! But this new life isn’t as easy as it sounds. Can Ho-Seok overcome the prejudices his neighbors have against him and make his dream come true? A slice-of-life story to warm your heart!

(Source: WEBTOON)

192370.description:
In 1948, the "liberation period" was not as free as its name suggests. Hae Ran, a designer who frees customers from their secrets at Gyeongseong Lingerie Shop, the first underwear shop in Joseon, is actually "Salsu" who assassinates anti-nationalists every full moon night under the orders of Heukyeong. Hae Ran, who is living a double life, is chased by the police officer Seok Ju one day, and collapses after someone finds out her identity... A warm hand that I feel for the first time in my life. Who was the benefactor that day who healed my wounds and protected me? Meanwhile, Heukyeong infiltrates the office disguised as a designer who studied abroad in order to keep an eye on Salsu. But the two of them end up harboring feelings for each other…

"Was our relationship… the key to escaping the cage? Or was it the shackles that bound us?"

A love triangle of liberation between three youths who chased each other’s tails to escape their cages.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

192371.description:
A distant universe's Goyeongbyeong is in danger of destruction! To solve this, the cat agent Jjonnyami is given the mission to conquer and explore Earth. However, on a rainy night, he fails to land safely and crashes to Earth. Meanwhile, So-Hee, who is on her way home after a hard night's work, finds Jjonnyami lying on the side of the road. She can't just pass him by and brings him home... This guy talks and has a huge appetite; he seems to be no ordinary cat! Maybe he's a little cute..? The story of the tumultuous Earth life of Jjonnyami, a lowly Earth invader, and So-Hee, an ordinary office worker living in reality!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

192372.description:
Disowned by his elite celebrity family for being "useless," Atsumu spent his youth in his sisters’ shadow—unbeknownst to everyone, he was the hidden genius behind their success all along! Now free from his family’s control, he’s swept into the entertainment world, catching the eye of top idols, models, and Vtubers who all recognize his true talent. But as he rises through the ranks—and finds himself surrounded by beautiful admirers—can this former backstage prodigy handle the spotlight AND live a normal high school life?!

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: After Being Banished from the Celebrity Family I Supported Behind the Scenes, All I Want Is to Enjoy a Normal Life.

192374.description:
Only in the corner of the room! The hidden power of the outcast Yeopo awakens!

Yeopo, a high school student who is active on the Internet as 'Red Toad 18'. A notorious keyboard warrior, he makes a mistake when writing down the school he goes to while having a keyboard battle with a user called 'Super Bear'. Super Bear, who sees Yeopo's past posts impersonating the student council president, the object of his admiration, and thinks that Red Toad 18 is the student council president, visits the school to punish Yeopo. Although he somehow overcomes the crisis, one of the bullies finds out that he is Red Toad 18, and Yeopo, who has been caught with his weakness, is reduced to a bread shuttle and is forced to give up his empty house as a drinking party venue for the bullies. However, Yeopo has a strange superpower that only works near his house...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: A warrior from the corner of his room

192375.description:
After 6 years, Cho-Ryeong returns, and her childhood friend Gwi-Myeong, who she thought was dead, is alive. And she has become a shaman. Gwi-Myeong has become so cold compared to when she was young. What happened in the meantime? Why do the spirits of the dead keep possessing the bodies of the living in this village? She must look deeply into the stories of the dead and the people left behind to find the secrets hidden by Cho-Ryeong and the Cho-Ryeong Shrine. And also, a way to save Gwi-Myeong.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

192376.description:
At the age of 20, three people met in the same club at a university in Seoul, Ko Tae-Young, Sa-Rang, and Dokgo I-Na. The three have been friends for 11 years in Seoul, where housing prices are high, people are crowded, and the night view is spectacular. Tae-Young, who yearned for a seemingly comfortable life, entered the design department and now works at an ordinary web design company. Sa-Rang, a nurse who has been dating her Seoul-born doctor boyfriend for over 10 years and has been living in Seoul. Dokgo I-Na, who is comfortable being alone and enjoys other people's relationships the most, became a webtoon writer. Now that they are 31, the three of them are trying new changes for a better life than now. Tae-Young, who broke up with her boyfriend, who worked at a small business for over 2 years, meets another man, and prepares to move to a large company, and Sa-Rang, who is breaking up with her boyfriend to get married. I-Na, who is trying to escape the loneliness of living and working alone. In Seoul, where it is easy to become lonely as many lives as there are, what kind of thirty-one years will they spend?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Once upon a time in the northern mountains, there lived beings with great powers. The most powerful were the Imae. Their chief decided to share their power with the weakest beings, the Foxes. They made a blood pact that was supposed to benefit both sides, but the Imae would always have the upperhand. The foxes decided to leave the mountains and have been hiding ever since. If I don’t use my powers in front of an Imae, I’ll be just fine, but now guess what happened…?

(Source: Tapas)

For Seo Jae-Yun, a seemingly innocent game of Secret Santa is about to change his life. After unwrapping his special gift, he is shocked to find a dildo - and one that can come to life, at that! The dildo will do anything to please his master, and try as he might, Jae-Yun can’t find it in himself to kick his newfound companion out. Instead, perhaps they can work together find the greatest gift of all...deep, deep inside.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Aubrey Sandalwood had one goal: to hide her past as a slave, and become the perfect lady in high society. But at her long-awaited debut party, she runs into a man from her past— the boy who rescued her from the island she was trapped on. Colhard Karnus, the only one who knows her secret.

Masato Kawamura, a beauty equipment salesman, is a gay man who has no luck with men, choosing them based on their faces and getting rejected all the time. One day, he met his younger childhood friend, Yui Shinohara, again after 9 years. As his face was Masato's type, he suddenly confessed his feelings and was crushed. Since then, whenever Masato broke his heart, he came to Yui's place to complain, drink, get involved, and relieve his sorrow. And one day, Yui kissed Masato, when he was heartbroken and frustrated as usual?!

(Source: cigarillo)

192391.description:
Ren Suwa is a legendary former host who now owns and manages a men's host club where customers are even allowed to kiss the staff. His life takes an unexpected turn when he falls in love at first sight with Asahi Narumi, an innocent university student interviewing for a job. Ren decides to hire Asahi; however, his innocent charm quickly pushes Ren's composure to its limits. When Ren finally follows his heart and kisses him, he is shocked to discover that he has just stolen the boy's very first kiss! The romantic comedy of a smooth-talking former host king who discovers true love for the very first time!

(Source: Takeshobo)

192393.description:
It all begins with a meteor shower. Soon after, reports spread of so-called Immortals. Each time they die, their bodies reset to an earlier point in time, with every wound, scar, and even the smallest scratch gone. Humanity is thrown into chaos, unable to explain the strange phenomenon. Two hundred years later, scientists still haven't been able to uncover the mystery of immortality. The Immortals now live in hiding: hunted, captured, and exploited as test subjects. They are forced to live, unable to die. Then, a rumor begins to spread of a man known only as the Undertaker— the one who can kill the Immortals.

(Source: WEBTOON)

192394.description:
In Murim, four of the most feared criminals were known as the "Bloodstorm Lions"—ruthless, merciless, and utterly irredeemable. But one day, they were given something unbelievable: a senior disciple. And not just any master... Their new "Grand Senior Brother" is an 8-year-old boy: Geom Woo-bin. Armed with an undeniable charm, handsome looks, and unshakable confidence, Woo-bin isn't here to reform these villains... He's here to rule Murim in his own way! Follow the chaotic and hilarious journey of this unlikely brotherhood, as the villains who once terrified the world now find themselves under the rule of an 8-year-old prodigy!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

192395.description:
Ten years after his master vanished while hunting a cult that unleashes yokai, young Taoist Dangchan saves Jin Seorang, a woman pursued by the ruthless Maewoldang sect. Known for enslaving people by turning them into yokai, Maewoldang is Jin Seorang's sworn enemy, and she seeks Dangchan's aid in destroying them. As they fight against dark sorcery, Dangchan discovers a startling truth—Maewoldang's leader holds clues to his master's disappearance. With the world still in turmoil, Dangchan wields his mystical arts, determined to restore order and fulfill his destiny.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 年上幼馴染みがショタコンじゃないと思った？
title.romaji: Toshiue Osananajimi ga Shotakon ja Nai to Omotta?

title.native: じゅーしー♥すてぃっく

192420.description:
Little A travels to a rural farm to reunite with the uncle who raised him only to find the place eerily silent and his uncle nowhere in sight. What awaits him is a chilling "bible" detailing how to care for the livestock… but something feels off. Because on this farm, the "livestock" aren’t animals they’re humans.

Now thrust into the role of acting farm manager, little A is forced to manage Mr. A’s Farm, a facility that produces livestock products using beast-like humans creatures who think and act like people, but are bred for their byproducts. Dark secrets plague the estate in the uncle’s absence. Little A must do all he can to keep the farm safe and sound...at least until his missing uncle, Mr.A, comes back.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
synonyms: Mr.A's Farm〜Aさんのちょっと怪しい農場〜

192421.description:
Min Ji-Ho’s idol career as a member of a mid-tier K-pop group member ends in emotional turmoil and disappointment. Ready to leave the industry behind for good, Ji-Ho unexpectedly finds himself filling in on a variety show…only to cross paths with Kang Tae-Yeon, the A-list actor he’s long admired. A lighthearted moment on set quickly spirals into a headline-making scandal: the first same-sex “incident” in the industry. Though the rumors fade as quickly as they came, Ji-Ho’s quiet exit is once again delayed. When an awkward reunion with former groupmate Park Hyeon-Do pulls him back into old tensions, Ji-Ho is forced to confront not just his past, but the unresolved wounds he thought he left behind with his life as an idol. In a world where appearances are everything, can Jiho uncover what he truly wants…and who he wants to stand beside him when the cameras are off?

(Source: Lezhin US)

192422.description:
Go Jun-Han is a punk, but he's smart. He's good at pretending to be a good person, and he doesn't get caught for his bad deeds. Despite his unfortunate family background, he seemed to have found a way to survive and become a successful influencer. Until he escaped a hit-and-run accident and met his annoying classmate from school, Shin Ha-Bin.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes one extra.

192423.description:
Eun-Ho, who is popular for his pretty face and tall stature, is having a flower-like youth, but... is a repeater. Unable to just sit by and watch Eun-Ho like that, his mother asks Seong-Jun, Eun-Ho's childhood friend and one year older, to tutor him. Eun-Ho goes to Seong-Jun to thank him and run an errand for side dishes...

...Huh? What are you doing now?

(Source: Bookcube, translated)
synonyms: I Wasn't Trying to Teach You This

192424.description:
When Wu-Shin moves into his new place, the last person he expects to run into is Jae-Hyeok, the same guy who made his school days a living hell. Out of work and behind on rent, Jae-Hyeok ends up crashing at Wu-Shin’s apartment, turning his peaceful new start into pure chaos. Instead of the terrifying bully from his memories, Wu-Shin now finds a lazy freeloader who trashes the house and drives him up the wall. But the Jae-Hyeok he remembers wasn’t always like this; he used to shine so brightly it hurt to look. What could have happened to turn him into such a mess, and can Wu-Shin survive living under the same roof as the one man he swore he’d never see again?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

192425.description:
A high school girl is trapped in an unfortunate life, living in despair...
Until one day, when she's suddenly summoned to another world!
The fresh start offers the girl hope for a new life.
The reason for her summoning is… to be the sleeping companion for a handsome cross-dressing princess!

(Source: Comic Newtype, translated)
synonyms: So fall asleep. Held by thee

title.native: 月はヒツジを数えない

192427.description: Tsuruko is forty-five years old, single, and a temporary worker. She lives for her two cats and has no interest in love or marriage. Then she receives an invitation to move in a share house with other handsome young men!

title.native: 鶴子はまだ四十五だから！

192428.description:
Lala is an energic and cheerful gal who likes fashion and makeup and spends her days hanging out with her friends. However, sometimes she feels like she's missing something, especially compared to people who work hard for their hobbies or dreams.
Kanade is a gloomy but gifted painter who spends his days painting alone in the school's art room. Their meeting will be the start of a precious friendship and the discovery of new dreams.

192429.description:
One day, an ordinary young man, Ichinose, is attacked by a beautiful woman named Moriya, who claims to be protecting the Earth from invaders from another world. Moriya tells Ichinose that the invaders are coming to Earth and tries to kill him, but Ichinose himself falls in love with Moriya's beauty at first sight!? Furthermore, when Ichinose expresses his gratitude to Moriya for protecting the Earth, Moriya suddenly begins crying... An ultra-fast love story that begins with the destruction of the Earth!

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)

title.romaji: Kono Endroll ni Koi wo Shita

192430.description:
What if your crush, who died in a tragic accident, suddenly returned? Yeongjin is stunned when Haon mysteriously reappears a year after the fire that took her life, revealing she traveled through time to meet him. With ten tickets to the future, can they change her fate and find their happily ever after?

(Source: Manta)

192431.description:
The main character, Riko, has always been in despair over her face, which is not becoming prettier despite her best efforts. The more she learns about beauty, the more she realizes the “genetic barrier” is impossible to overcome. In other words, if the "base" is not good, then there is nothing one can do to improve it. Then, an unexpected encounter comes to her... the ghost of a beauty influencer!?
This manga includes many life hacks and tips, from makeup to surgery.

Note: Originally serialized under the title "Kao Totonoi ni wa Wakaranai".

title.native: 顔整いには理解らない

192432.description:
Eight years after Woojae’s worst heartbreak, Haesoo, the one who got away, walks back into his life. Ready to reignite the flames, Woojae discovers Haesoo’s taste for D/S relationships. Woojae reluctantly agrees to give it a shot, signing up to be her submissive partner. But with both lacking the know-how, the question looms: will their second chance at love lead to another downfall?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Be Good, Then I'll Be Sweeter

192433.description:
Yoon Jiwoo is both shocked and worried when her twin sister Jia drops a bombshell, saying that she secretly got married. Still, Jiwoo is determined to help Jia persuade their parents... until she learns that the groom's brother is her ex-boyfriend, Moonkyung. What's more, there's a complicated history between the two families. Now they must work together to resolve the misunderstanding and change their parents' minds. Will these unlikely allies successfully pull off this fraud and become family?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes ten side stories.
synonyms: 初恋の彼と重縁大作戦！

192435.description:
In noble society, while most people care more about house or status than love when seeking a partner, this couldn't be any less the case for Grace Shellgrave, the daughter of a marquis with memories of a troubled past life. Seeking a true connection with someone who feels the same way, she attends a masquerade ball in secret. After spending a romantic night with Alan, a man who seems to share the same values, she soon finds out she's become pregnant... and to make matters worse, Alan is actually the heir to House Ward, the sworn arch-enemy of the Shellgraves! Alan aggressively pursues Grace, but she refuses to let her baby become a pawn for another typical noble. Does he just want an heir? Or could it actually be... love? Two equally awkward opposites attract in this aristocratic love story!

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: I'm Pregnant, but I Won't Marry Without Love

title.english: Blessed by Fate, Defiant in Love
title.native: 授かりましたが、愛なき結婚はいたしません
title.romaji: Sazukari Mashitaga, Ai Naki Kekkon wa Itashimasen

192436.description:
Neighbor trouble 5 seconds in!?

(Sorce: Fakku!)

Note: Published in COMIC X-EROS #104

192437.description:
A night under the same roof, yet unable to become one...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in COMIC X-EROS #123

title.native: なんでもしてくれる瑠璃花ちゃん

192440.description:
Annabelle, daughter of a Baron family fallen from grace, was enjoying a quiet and peaceful life with Felix, her childhood friend and son of the Pope. However, she couldn't shake the nagging feeling of inferiority due to their difference in social standing. Then, their peaceful daily life was abruptly cut short when Felix left for the Feneola Grand Cathedral, the head institution of the official religion. However, when she turned 17, Annabelle was summoned to the same cathedral because of her flower-like mark, a sign that she was a saintess known as the “Flower Maiden.” Annabelle was excited at the thought of reuniting with Felix, but for some reason, he seemed cold and distant. To add insult to injury, Beatrice, a beautiful young lady from the Count Family, was also summoned there as a Flower Maiden! Felix now had to choose one of them as the “true” Flower Maiden. Will Annabelle have what it takes to become the Flower Maiden...?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

title.english: The Cold Pope Won't Give Up on the Flower Maiden
title.native: 無愛想な教皇は瑞花の乙女を諦めない
title.romaji: Buaisouna Kyoukou wa Mizu Hana no Otome wo Akiramenai

title.native: リカちゃんは都会に行きたい

192444.description:
Divorced by her abusive ex, she's now cherished by her new husband! Chloé, a Baron's daughter, was divorced by her corrupt noble ex-husband because she 'couldn't bear a child.' Left alone with a broken heart, she suddenly receives a marriage proposal from someone she never expected--the notorious 'wife-killer,' Marquis Roland! Though renowned throughout the kingdom for his capabilities, he remains a man of mystery, never removing his mask. Despite Chloé's fears, why does Roland treat her with nothing but love and kindness as they embark on their new life together as newlyweds...?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)
synonyms: Ma première fois avec mon mystérieux second mari

title.native: 離縁されました。再婚しました。

192446.description:
In the first year of her marriage, Keiko Natori enjoys being a full-time housewife and having a great relationship with her husband. Surrounded by a circle of cherished friends, among them her dear younger sister Shiho, Keiko's life seems blissful in every aspect. However, her happiness is shattered when her beloved sister betrays her trust by seducing her husband. Thus begins a tumultuous battle for affection between the two sisters, sparked by the flames of an illicit affair—who will emerge victorious in this emotional tug-of-war?

"Sister... I only wish for your misery to exceed mine."

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)
synonyms: 我的幸福來自妳的不幸

title.native: どうか私より不幸でいて下さい

192450.description:
"I'd like to borrow Botan for a while." Botan is a female ninja about to get married. She is asked by her uncle, who is also a benefactor, to help support the declining samurai estate and her beloved lord. As invited and ordered by her uncle, she hides from the master she should be serving and lets her small body be violated. Despite her reason, which she sees as a duty, her body inevitably responds to the pleasure...

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

Note: Released at Comic Market 103, 105

title.native: 好色の忠義くノ一ぼたん

192455.description:
Akane and Kaede are twins who look identical. Their parents force them to "become more like a girl" and "more like a boy..." so they come up with a "challenge"...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

192456.description:
Ellenoa doesn't dare dream of a happy ending. Treated like a lowly housemaid by her own family, she decides to rewrite her fate by approaching Duke Enoch Bayern Frederich, a jaded rake shrouded in cynicism and disillusionment, with an offer he cannot resist--a glimpse into the future in exchange for a year of companionship. He agrees to the contract, not knowing that the knowledge comes with a dreadful cost--one that could claim Ellenoa's very life.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: Cendrillon et l'amour à durée limitée

192458.description:
The popular senior magical girl Laura. What is her true identity that she is hiding?! She must complete her magical girl duties without being found out by anyone!

(Source: Bufftoon, translated)

192459.description:
This is the story of how a fake family becomes a real family. Kanon is a 29-year-old girl manga artist. She lives a lackluster life, half-hearted in both work and love. But one day, her sister and her husband die in an accident, and she ends up taking in her 5-year-old niece and becoming a parent...!? She's never even thought about having children. Not only is she unmarried, but her relationship with her boyfriend is half-hearted. And yet, she suddenly becomes a parent...!?

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

192460.description:
The Professor Human Feces Incident, the professor stealing his student's thesis, and idol unfair admissions! The creepy stories that happened in college begin!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

192461.description:
An humorous "record" of the author's experiences in the manhua industry, full of laughter and tears.

(Source: Yiben Manhua, translated)

192464.description:
Deep in the mountains, among the people of Yeong-Ji who say that a woman's happiness is marriage, a suspicious man with a somewhat naive look that I picked up in the garden near my house a while ago appeared. The man introduced himself as my husband..., but whenever this happens, the look in this man's eyes looks dangerous?

Jayden, who is unconventional and ignorant of the ways of the world, but has a great appearance. She comforted and appeased the beastly man, making him human, and furthermore, tamed him to her taste. However, the people who came to find this man a while later seemed amazing.

"I came to pick you up, hyung."

It seems that the status of this naive husband that I picked up is not ordinary.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: If You Pick Up a Suspicious Husband

192466.description:
Welcome to Frère, a picture-purrfect share bookstore tucked away in a cozy corner of Shinjuku, complete with its very own adorable cat mascots! In a shared bookstore, each shelf is curated by individual “shelf owners,” each contributing their own books and personal touch to the space. Inside, you’ll meet as many fascinating and unique people as there are books: a hairstylist struggling to keep up with the latest trends, a student trying to make ends meet, a bartender eager to understand people through literature, and other colorful patrons seeking the perfect read. Peek into their lives and watch their relationships blossom as they connect over their shared love of books and the stories that bring them together.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: A Good Day Starts with Cats and Books
title.romaji: Shodana no Hon to Neko Biyori

192467.description:
Asahi is doing great at work and his personal life, making the most of his good communication skills and good looks. His colleagues who know his true nature call him "sleazy." But when his schoolmate Okuyama comes to work as a temporary worker at his company, Asahi's daily life starts to change...

This is a love story between a man who uses any "piece" he can and a "bottom-of-the-barrel girl" who doesn't move the way he wants.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

192468.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2021 October issue.

192469.description:
Oh, I'm the strongest demon cult member of the Nine Heavens, but I know how to return to the demon cult.

The absolute being who trampled the martial arts world and reigned at the top, Gucheon. He was the one who led the Demonic Cult to its peak, and to the Jeongpa, he was called the Heavenly Demon itself. The last Demonic Cult war fought by all the martial arts sects including Goopa. After a fierce battle, Gucheon was killed by an unknown being.

The moment I thought it was all over... I opened my eyes not in the martial arts world, but in a weak body in the modern era?!

"What is this...? This strange place?! Send me back!!"

Gucheon descends into the modern era...!!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: Heavenly Demon Goes to High School
Top Delinquent of the Demonic Sect

192472.description:
Ho Yeon-Woo is a perfect man with looks, abilities, and even aura. However, he is the worst as a romantic partner, only pursuing casual encounters and mercilessly rejecting serious partners. Despite knowing this, he is called a 'fox' instead of 'Yeon-Woo' because there are many people who are attracted to him. In fact, he is... a real fox! The fox-like 'Hoin-Jok' gains life from the hearts of humans towards him. The deeper and greater the feelings, the better, but Yeon-Woo for some reason avoids deep hearts and instead rejects them when they become serious. Yeon-Woo, unable to absorb good life force, eventually falls ill and collapses. If this continues, he will die within a year. There is only one solution: find someone with a huge heart and make them fall in deep love to gain that power. Yeom-Hwa, the leader of the Hoin-Jok, injects Yeon-Woo with divine power into his eyes, allowing him to see the hearts of each person. However, the owner of the huge heart that he found after searching hard enough is a man...? And he is a judo player with broad shoulders, a college student, and a famous blunt and stubborn Go Jeong-In! Heterosexual? The other person just can't stand it? You don't need anything else. If you want to live, "Turn your life around!"

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: Seduce Me With All Your Might

192473.description:
One day, Miki, whose hobby is making dioramas, witnesses her boyfriend Hayato, who works at the same company, cheating on her. Shocked, Miki dreams of drinking tea made by a mysterious boy in the tea room of the diorama she made. Miki's heart is eased thanks to the dream, but she learns on the news that the boy who appeared in her dream has been in an accident and is currently in critical condition...!?

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

192478.description:
Speech balloons, or balloons for short, are objects that appear once spoken, showing the speaker’s exact words right near them. Balloons and the language they show are controlled by the black towers. There exist approximately 6900 in the world, and within them…

(Source: Glacier Bay Books)

title.romaji: Madamada, Ii Ko Ii Ko tte shite

192480.description:
Amemori, a marginal job-hunting gap student who has lost 28 consecutive job interviews, decides to start a part-time job as a writer (miscellaneous work) for a miscellaneous online news site. Amemori goes out to cover spots that have become the talk of the Internet, such as SNS and occult message boards, but everywhere she goes, she encounters a number of bizarre phenomena that are hard to believe....
Urban legends and SNS are woven together to create a new type of netlore horror.
--Is that urban legend really “just a rumor”?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

192485.description: 1st iteration of the character Miko-chan. This manga was featured on back covers of shoujo manga magazines like Lala, Hitomi or Ribon DX during the Shouwa era.

192486.description:
Rio is a completely average high school second-year, while her best friend Katsuki is pretty enough to turn everyone's heads. Sometimes Rio feels like she's just there to make Katsuki's beauty stand out better... or even worse, that she's invisible to the whole world. Discouraged as she is, Rio was holding onto a faint hope of love with Haruta, the only person at school who ever seems to notice her. When she realizes one day that he has a crush on Katsuki rather than her, she's so upset that she flees the classroom, wishing she could finally just disappear for real. But, while she's nursing her hurt feelings, someone comes and finds her; it's none other than "the reaper," aka Echizenya, the gloomy guy who's always hiding away in the corner creeping out their classmates. Enjoy this adorable will-they-won't-they romance between the "plain best friend" and the secret hottie undercover as the class weirdo!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

転生アイドルとドルオタの騎士 2 ‐恋人編‐

192491.description:
“Is that your wish?”

When a casual wish for a reverse harem of gorgeous men backfires, Hong Minji, a modern woman with more-than-average sex drive, finds herself trapped in a hardcore smut as the main character, Saint Agnes. Surrounded by endless temptation, she must be careful not to fall into the traps of a bad ending. However… why not enjoy herself in the meantime?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

192494.description:
I, Kurumi Nabana, and my classmate Seira Sorahashi aren't friends. In fact, we hardly ever talk in the classroom. I am a plain, ordinary girl, and she is widely considered to be the cutest girl in school, so our social circles do not intersect. Until one day, when Seira summoned me with a note to meet after school.

"Kurumi,” she said, ”Would you like to be my master?"

My daily life is dramatically changed because of this ridiculous “request." I tried to think of excuses, but I wouldn't want anyone else to hurt Sorahashi-san. So I said, “I'll do it....... I'll put it on."

From today, I will be her master. Put a collar on her, train her, and take her for a walk behind closed doors.

What in the world are we doing?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The princess of the class is my doggie.
The Princess of Our Class is My Puppy

192499.description:
Park Tae-Won never expected to fall in love with an alpha, let alone one twice divorced with a teenage son. But when tragedy strikes, Tae-Won finds himself alone with that son, Ahn Sang-Woo, a boy he never managed to understand. Then Sang-Woo starts getting closer. Too close. And when Tae-Won unexpectedly presents as an omega, what was once grief and confusion curdles into something far more dangerous. Now entangled in a bond steeped in grief and sin, Tae-Won is consumed by guilt he cannot confess, and a craving he cannot cleanse. Some attachments aren’t born of love...

They’re worn like a crown of thorns.

(Source: Lezhin US)

192500.description:
“If you let me make rice cake, I won’t eat you.”

While crossing the mountain in the middle of the night to find medicinal herbs for his sick mother, the filial son Park Dal-Jae encounters a fearsome thousand-year-old tiger and the mountain master, Baek-Ho. When he suddenly gave rice cake to the tiger who was looking for rice cake, wow! What it bit was not my neck or the rice cake I held out, but a large pepper(?) hanging between its legs.

“Oh, oh. The pepper is gone!”
“Stop. I’ll suck it out and return it to its original state.”

Where did something so delicious come from!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

In Joseon's capital of Hanyang, rumors are spreading of an evil king cursing the kingdom with ghosts. First, there's the wailing man pulling an empty handcart. A lady assassin who falls in love with her target, an eight-year-old little girl, and decides to retire from being an assassin to become her secret protector.

192639.description:
Taeyoon Bong is a webnovelist infamous for writing the most tragic endings for his characters. Taeyoon believes this is due to what happened five years ago--back then, he was an idol trainee ready to debut with his hyungs. That all changed when a drunk driver ran into their car and shattered their reality. Taeyoon was the only survivor. One night, he answers a mysterious call from a hyung he long thought dead, throwing him back to that fateful night...

The worst part about falling in love? Being asked to help someone else win him over.

When kind-hearted college student Hiyori is asked to play matchmaker for Shino, the handsome and enigmatic campus heartthrob, he reluctantly agrees, despite harboring feelings for him himself. After all, someone as popular as Shino could never be interested in an ordinary guy like him. Then, after a shift at their part-time job, Hiyori asks whether Shino has a girlfriend.

"No. But there is someone I like."

Heartbroken, Hiyori prepares to move on... until Shino's next words leave him speechless.

"It's you."

If you can't save a woman, you won't be able to save the world! Will you believe in love or in heaven? A mountain man with an unknown background travels through the world carrying a pot lid, a family heirloom. The story of a real man who shakes the world from the central plains to the new world!

This is a hilarious quick-transmigration comic. Lily's mission is to shuttle through various novel worlds and fulfill the wishes of small potatoes, like helping them get rid of bad romances or changing their miserable fates. Wait, her boss is an aloof guy in ancient-style attire, and he's kind of attractive!

192652.description:
In the midst of a world shrouded in mystery, where an enigmatic power resurges, fear and trepidation grip the hearts of all. However, amidst the chaos, Jiang Che remains unruffled, unaffected by the enigma, and even capable of perceiving peculiar clues. With audacity, he fearlessly takes on roles as a caretaker in the Hades Hospital, a server in the Underworld Hotel, and a network administrator in the Cycle Internet Cafe... He goes as far as constructing a prison within the enigmatic realm, designed to confine deities!

(Source: Webnovel)

192653.description:
A few years after the Demon Lord’s defeat, the kingdom holds a memorial service to honor the lives lost in the battle, and the Hero takes this opportunity to reunite with the princess of Ludonia, whom he first met at the beginning of his journey. But the princess is not happy to see him; in fact, she accuses him of murdering her elder brother, the Hero of Ludonia. The Hero is quick to refute this, and that triggers a trip down memory lane…one that leads him to recall the circumstances that led to the other Hero’s death.

Ryousuke, a shut-in who’s a die-hard — no, hopelessly in love — fan of Hamura Yuusei, one half of the comedy duo “Mangosteen,” spends his days submitting jokes to their radio show's listener segment. But when Mangosteen suddenly announces their disbandment, Ryousuke is devastated and loses all will to live. That is, until one day, the very Hamura Yuusei himself shows up uninvited at Ryousuke’s family home…!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

192655.description: The war between humans and witches has ended. Quo, a girl who is the ultimate superhuman soldier also known as a "Witch Hunter," receives an order to "hide her identity and live a normal school life" in order to prove her own safety. If she fails, she will be disposed of immediately, making it a life-threatening mission. However, she has an even bigger problem. Quo is extremely shy and has the weakest communication skills. Furthermore, at the school where she infiltrates, she meets Luca, a survived enemy who desires peace, and Noel, a junior "Witch Hunter" who transferred to the school to monitor Quo's mission --!?

192656.description:
The long-running war between mankind and demons has left humanity in a desperate situation. Macha is a powerful alchemist fighting on the front lines, and one day her mother and engineer, Dilia, tells her that she has succeeded in creating a “homunculus” using alchemy. According to Dilia, by having the homunculus fight in battle, they can defeat the demons without further loss of life. While the rest of the team is elated, Macha is troubled by the fact that her role as a warrior is being diminished.

What am I going to do if they don't even expect me to fight anymore…

Will he accept twisted love-or face death? Time to steel your resolve.

After being reincarnated as a cultist mob in the notoriously brutal eroge Seeker of the Netherlight, Oakley has only one goal: escape the deranged cult before he ends up sacrificed like all the rest. But during a battle with the forces of the Kenneth Orthodoxy, one reckless move earns him the attention of a savage female executive-and worse, the mad cult leader.

Now, his everyday life gets a hellish upgrade as he tries to survive in a world where the heroines are all completely unhinged, eyes blazing with the kind of resolve that laughs in the face of death... and they all seem disturbingly fixated on him. His life-and his chastity-are on the line in a no-save nightmare route.

Warning: This story contains nothing but cute girls with severely messed-up kinks and an unhealthy obsession with the protagonist.

(Source: Hanashi Media)

192658.description:
Sixteen-year-old Inari Anamori has always had a soft spot for animals. But on his first day at his new school, things take a wild turn—he’s suddenly attacked by a bizarre creature he encountered in the forest! Just when things look grim, he’s rescued by Gunze Arabaki, a mysterious loner with a deep disdain for people. Their fateful encounter throws Inari headfirst into a chaotic school life filled with strange creatures, wild antics, and nonstop surprises. Get ready for the start of Kyosuke Usuta’s latest gag manga—an off-the-wall comedy where the weird is just getting started!

Twelve extremely beautiful and talented women... each one an elite goddess of their field and possessing unparalleled beauty... Xiao Lin must form contracts with them in order to extend his life! Thus, he is forced to embark on the path of hunting for these goddesses!

He set out on a leisurely journey to search for ore to aid his research, but... the beautiful hero (disciple) who admired him wouldn't let him be!! She had already made preparations to build him a home in order to repay him but it was all a ploy to keep him for herself?!
But not only did the tomboyish female alchemist barge in as well, he also caught the attention of the troublesome eldest son of a marquis...
"Come at me, I'll settle this with one punch." "As expected of my master!!"
Unwavering like a rock, unleashing a devastating single punch that shows no mercy!

Luciella Sullivan finds herself trapped in an arranged marriage to Silas Chase, the powerful Ninth Prince of the genetically superior Beastkin royal family on Planet Alpha. Though the union was orchestrated by Luciella's scheming sister, not her own wishes, Silas refuses to let his alluring wife abandon him. As Luciella battles for her freedom, she uncovers dangerous undercurrents in this advanced alien society. Navigating court intrigue and her own complex feelings, Luciella must decide how far she'll go to control her destiny on Alpha, where ancient dynasties and advanced technology collide.

To his left, the cool and detached gyaru, Ichinose Yuria. And to his right, the refined, black-haired class rep, Kuroki Ruri. All he wanted was a quiet otaku life—so how did things end up like this?!

After quitting her high-pressure job, Seo-Ri returns home and reluctantly joins swimming lessons at her brother’s urging. There, she meets instructor Yu-Jeong — her brother’s friend, who instantly recognizes her as his first love. Under summer’s heat and rain, a heart-fluttering romance begins.

Fresh out of the military, he learns his “innocent” girlfriend’s been playing him all along—and sleeping around, even with his tormentor. With the help of his childhood friend, he plots revenge to expose her true face.

On the first snow of that year, Shan Xianchun was asked by her roommate to be a photographer for a cosplay shoot. Unexpectedly she captures a girl with long hair and green dress through her camera. The girl looked at her with complex and affectionate eyes and Shan Xianchun felt as if her heart was scratched...

Finally, she got her first match and went to meet them, only to find it was her coworker Itou?! Was he teasing her by matching with her? "I was hoping you'd hurry up and get divorced," he said, coming on to her. His seriousness, the touch of his fingers—these were feelings she hadn't experienced in so long...!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 9 episodes and 3 chapters respectively.

title.english: I'll Love You If You're Divorced
title.native: 離婚したなら愛しますけど？～一途な後輩はご無沙汰バツイチに求愛中
title.romaji: Rikon Shita nara Aishimasu kedo? - Ichizu na Kouhai wa Gobusata Batsuichi ni Kyuuai-chuu

192732.description:
After a one-night stand with a charismatic coworker, Rio is taken by surprise when he suddenly proposes! All after being let down by her boyfriend after he forgot their birthday promise. Of course, once a man gets what he wants, he often stops caring. Feeling down, Rio is uplifted when her coworker Miyamoto steps in. Despite being charming and charismatic, he tells her, "I would never make you sad. If you were my girlfriend, I'd take responsibility." Inspired by his conviction, Rio challenges him: "Prove it to me." With a sweet and passionate love that can melt hearts, will his straightforwardness help her rediscover happiness?

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 9 episodes and 3 chapters respectively.

title.native: ワンナイト求婚～陽キャ同期は一途で愛重め～
title.romaji: One Night Kyuukon: Youkya Douki wa Ichizu de Ai Choume

192733.description:
The hectic everyday schedule at work made this office lady, Natsuki, fall asleep during sex with her boyfriend, causing him to break up with her. Natsuki takes her work very seriously but wouldn't mind losing to her cool, popular co-worker, Hiejima... Feeling down during a business trip, an accident forces the two to share a room for the night. Because Hiejima seemed so dry, Natsuki felt comfortable and fell asleep easily but does Hiejima have hidden feelings...? "I just want you to feel good..." he tells her as he uses his fingers, kissing her sleeping face, waking her from her sleep--But was this a dream? Or...

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 27 episodes and 9 chapters respectively.

title.english: Dozing in Desire: A Sweet, Passionate Night with My Cool Colleague
title.native: まどろみ、乱れて、欲しがって～クールな同期は夜通し私を甘濡らす
title.romaji: Madoromi, Midarete, Hoshigatte:  Cool na Douki wa Yodoushi Watashi wo Ama Nurasu

192734.description:
My boyfriend, Renji, is 2 years older than me and we've been dating for a while now, but we haven't really been affectionate yet. I love that he's such a gentleman but I wish he showed he wanted me more. It made me start to think, "Maybe he doesn't find me attractive..." When I told him this, he said, "No. You're the only one I find attractive. I feel like we would never stop having sex." He wraps me up, filling me up with his love... It feels so good―!

(Source: Coolmic)

192735.description:
Haruka, an ordinary office worker, grapples with both professional setbacks and romantic turmoil due to her constantly serious face. Feared by colleagues and dumped for being unreadable, she finds solace in the one person who seems to penetrate her facade—her boss, Tachibana. Their paths intertwine further when they are assigned to collaborate on a project. Tachibana, with his uncanny ability to decipher her emotions, playfully warns Haruka, "Don't let yourself fall too hard for me while working together." Haruka is left bewildered by Tachibana's perceptiveness. Could he read her mind?! Why does he see through everything?!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 18 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.

title.english: My Smokin' Hot Boss Can See Right Through Me
title.native: 君の好きバレ、もっとちょうだい～理想の上司はぜんぶお見通し
title.romaji: Kimi no Suki Bare, Motto Choudai: Risou no Joushi wa Zenbu wo Mitoushi

192736.description:
Living a content life as an ordinary office lady, Aoi finds herself reminiscing about a past flame—a former boyfriend with whom she shared an undeniable chemistry so intense they had to break up to avoid becoming consumed by their passion. However, things change when a new employee joins the company, and it's none other than her former boyfriend! Witnessing him effortlessly charming other women, Aoi is reminded of his playboy reputation and resolves to keep her distance. Yet, fate has other plans. That evening, Aoi's current boyfriend unexpectedly requests to have a talk?! And as if her world isn't already turned upside down, she later finds herself face to face with her ex, he exclaims with confidence, "It turns out I am your soulmate, after all." Will she succumb to his intoxicating touch?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: I Just Can't Quit My Ex
title.native: 運命のカラダと別れたい。～思い出したくなかった、元カレとのズブズブH
title.romaji: Unmei no Karada to Wakaretai. - Omoi Dashitaku na Katta, Motokare to no Zubuzubu H

192737.description:
A girl who turns every guy she dates into a loser. Spending her night out drinking and complaining to her friend about her relationship problems, her friend says, "I'm already a loser...," and proposes that she goes out with him! She thought he was just some loser, but in reality he is the kind of guy who can love her wholeheartedly. It would be dangerous to fall for him!!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 9 episodes and 3 chapters respectively.

title.english: I'm Falling For My (Loser) Guy Friend!
title.native: 与一くんは、カラダたらし。～尽くし系女子、(惚れたら)ダメな男につかまる
title.romaji: Yoichi-kun wa, Karada Tarashi. - Tsukushi-kei Joshi, (Horetara) Dame na Otoko ni Tsukamaru

192738.description:
We hate each other so much that our subordinates worry at work... but we're actually just liars who deeply desire each other. These two from different sales departments keep fighting to put on a show. There's so much discord that it's hard to believe. But it was a "fake fight" to increase the cohensiveness of the deparment! Even though these two really get along, they keep acting like they hate each other! She offers a truce, "If you take off your suit, we can end this feud..."

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 9 episodes and 3 chapters respectively.
synonyms: Wake Atte Kenen no Naka desu ga, Suit wo Nuidara Beta Hore desu

title.english: I Hate You in the Office, But Love You After Work
title.native: ワケあって犬猿の仲ですが、スーツを脱いだらベタ惚れです
title.romaji: Wake Atte Kenen no Naka desu ga, Suit wo Nuidara Betabore desu

title.native: ドスケベバキュームマ♥コ幼稚園

192741.description:
When portals called “gates” opened in 1997, humanity was thrown into chaos as monsters ravaged the planet. Countless lives were lost, including Eunha Cha’s mother. Left to fend for herself, Eunha one day mysteriously awakens a new power. Drafted into the military to fight alongside other Hunters, she sets out on what was supposed to be a routine mission inside a C-rank gate. But when she becomes trapped inside, she’s forced to fight relentlessly against waves of monsters as the gate resets endlessly... until a voice calls out to her.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: LV. 99 The Princess of Dark Flare
เจ้าหญิงเพลิงกาฬเลเวล 99

192742.description:
After being fired from his company due to his violent temperament, Takehisa returns to his family home for the first time in 7 years. He finds that his previously angelic little brother, Rio, who used to adore him, has grown into a handsome and intelligent but devious person. While somewhat contemptuous towards his older brother, the two manage to coexist for the most part. That is until Takehisa sees his brother having a sexual encounter with a random man in a park restroom...

(Source: KOOI., translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

192744.description:
"We'll only know if we do it again, right?" There's no mistaking it. Your voice, your heavy breathing... my body remembers. You're the one I'm destined for... the one I slept with that night at the ball!

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: 밤 12시, 녹아드는 열기 -몸이 기억하는 운명의 신데렐라-

title.native: 午前0時、とけあう熱～カラダが覚えてる運命のシンデレラ
title.romaji: Gozen 0-ji, Tokeau Netsu: Karada ga Oboeteru Unmei no Cinderella

192745.description:
"I love you." I can hear the sweet words coming from both sides and it makes my body two times hotter. Doing it with two of my precious friends, even though it's wrong!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 24 episodes and 8 chapters respectively.

title.native: 犬甘兄弟の甘やかな猛愛に注意。
title.romaji: Inuama Kyoudai no Amayaka na Mou Ai ni Chuui.

192746.description:
"I don't want any man besides me seeing you looking this cute." It's the first time I've ever seen this jealous side of my childhood friend. With the way he's touching me, these beautiful clothes he put me in will be ruined...

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 18 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.

title.native: もっと可愛く、乱してあげる～幼馴染モデルの溺愛プロデュース
title.romaji: Motto Kawaiku, Ran shite Ageru: Osananajimi Model no Dekiai Produce

192747.description:
"I'm in the mood now. Can I make love to you?" The calm Shiina suddenly becomes manly. Don't make me feel... any better than this...!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 18 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.

title.english: You're Too Cute for Me to Be Gentle
title.native: 可愛すぎだよ、優しくできない。～おっとり椎名さんはベッドの上では手加減知らず
title.romaji: Kawaisugi da yo, Yasashiku Dekinai. Ottori Shiina-san wa Bed no Ue de wa Tekagen Shirazu

192748.description:
Vampire yakuza and a detective. Romance overcoming differences in status with the youngest Prime Minister in the history who's an alpha.

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Drive Me Wild With Your Sweet Fangs

192749.description:
"Please, will you birth my child?" Just one sweet kiss from the prince and I lost my mind... Is this what A once-in-a-millennium compatibility is...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 39 episodes and 13 chapters respectively.

title.english: A Once in a Millennium Love

title.romaji: 1000-nen ni Ichido no Chigiri: Funou Ouji wa Watashi ni Dake Zetsurin desu

192750.description:
"I'll have you take responsibility for making an Incubus fall for you." My older male manager is actually an Incubus? My energy is being sucked until my body melts…

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 18 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.

title.romaji: Inma-sama ni Aishi Midasareru Koto wo Chikaimasu ka?

192751.description:
"I'll make you come until you can't stand up anymore." Deeply and indulgently corrupted by my handsome boss' secret first-rate sex technique…

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 9 episodes and 3 chapters respectively.

title.english: A Surprise Kiss and a Beast's Secret Desire
title.native: 不意打ちキス、のち、男の顔。～堅物エリートは、獣な牙を隠してる
title.romaji: Fuiuchi Kiss, Nochi, Otoko no Kao. Katabutsu Elite wa, Kemono na Kiba wo Kakushiteru

192752.description:
Man, King, Virtue, and Divinity. The "Four Paths of Light" thought to guide one's way to the moral way of life and humanity is no longer pursued. In its place is the "Four Paths of Sin"; where one lives only for their desires... In a world that is in chaos with rampant looting and murder, one man with hope and humanity at his core dares to pursue the righting of humankind... The provoking story of sword battle fantasy is back!

(Source: Alpha Manga)

192753.description:
I won't let you go until you're mine. Ms. Adachi has reached her wits end dealing with her bully of a boss, Mr. Hiyama. Luckily, her co-worker Mr. Makihara that she's fantasized about for years is coming back from his overseas work transfer. When she passes out drunk after the office party celebrating his return, she's awakened by a kiss...but from who? Surely it was from the co-worker she adores so much, Mr. Makihara...or was it?

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 18 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.

title.english: Forget Him, Fall For Me Instead!
title.native: アイツじゃなくて、俺に溺れて？～あの夜から…上司の熱が消えてくれない
title.romaji: Aitsu Janakute, Ore ni Oborete?: Ano Yoru kara... Joushi no Netsu ga Kiete Kurenai

192754.description:
Li Zimo meets an untimely demise in a tragic traffic accident, only to be reborn as a disciple in a prestigious cultivation sect. While the sect's grandmaster appears cold and unapproachable, there is a hidden side to his handsome demeanor...

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Hold It Right There, Mr. Two-Face!

192755.description:
Rumors fly that in House of Masks, all your wishes will come true if invited to a drink after the bar closes. But how many secrets are hidden by the boss and the Princess of the Mask Tribe?

(Source: WebComics)

192756.description:
The heart of the emperor, the love of the fox spirit... In this life, the king of Zhou is just a scholar, and the resentment of the past life is just in memory; infatuated Da Ji, across time and space in order to chase love, will never regret. Different fates of familiar characters in history, let's to feel their love and hate...

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: I am not a bad fox!

192757.description:
"Wait, you mean to tell me that the chickens I raise are pure-blood Phoenixes? And the carp I raise are true dragons? And even the weeds in my yard are top-grade elixir? Li Fan couldn't believe his ears. 'No, it's impossible,' he exclaimed. 'How could I, a mere young man from the city, become a peerless powerhouse?'
But fate had other plans for Li Fan. One day, he found himself transported through time to ancient times, where he quickly rose to become a top-level powerhouse, revered by various sect masters. With his incredible strength, he set out to dominate the world. Let's follow his journey and see how he overcomes all challenges that come his way!"

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: I Am Really Not an Matchless Genius

title.english: Fantasy: I Am Not a Master

192758.description:
Wei Haoran is a rich, handsome, and overbearing CEO. However, he got played by some random woman: She took advantage of him, and... ran away right after? No matter in which corner of the world she ran to, he'll definitely find her! But one day, suddenly, a little boy appears in front of him, calling him father. What is going on?!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Let Me Go, You stony Man
Let Me Go, Your Cold Boss

192759.description:
The all-knowing Yuan Qiqi possesses all the secrets of the world, but he forgot his own past. In the "Buddha Killed People" incident at Yuchan Temple, Yuan Qiqi met up with constable Chu Zhong, and together they solved one murder case after another... They became a golden pair. In the course of investigating murders, the pieces of his memory were slowly being put together, and Yuan Qiqi's identity was gradually revealed...

(Source: Webnovel)

192760.description:
The demon prince led the his brothers to the human world to carry out the "successor test". He forced Wen Xi'er who was just beginning to fall in love, to have a love affair with her. The domineering prince frequently becomes jealous and uses various seductive tricks for showing his charm. Can the cute human girl tame the scheming demon prince and reap a thrilling but interesting sweet first love?

(Source: WebComics)

192761.description:
Ji-Yu, a timid high school girl who wants to live an ordinary life, saves her childhood friend Do-Kyung from jumping off the rooftop on the first day of moving in. Together with Do-Kyung, who was a victim of school bullying, Ji-Yu begins an unexpected high school survival story.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

192762.description:
One day, when he came home, there were four legs on his bed. Normally, he would be shocked by this sight, but Seo-Hyun Lee found it intriguing. He was even more intrigued by the fact that the legs were his twin brother and his lover. This intrigue led Seo-Hyun Lee to think in a different direction. A lover with similar tastes, a brother who was just like his other half. Then, couldn't his brother also be in a relationship with his lover? This wrong idea led the relationship between the three people in a completely unexpected direction.

(Source: Bookcube, translated)

192763.description:
"You'll live here as my wife for just one year."

Judy, the daughter of a baron, accepted an arranged marriage with a wealthy commoner to protect her family and the people of her territory. However, her husband threatened to divorce her in a year! Judy decides to take revenge on her husband's betrayal and her harsh married life...!

(Source: SHINE Partners, translated)
synonyms: 계약 아내가 사랑하는 남편을 위해 복수해보겠습니다

title.romaji: Fukushuu wa Rikon no Nochi de

192764.description:
The world is encased in winter due to the advances of the Ice Kingdom. Kind-hearted Otr, who dreams of being a warrior like his dad, has been entrusted with keeping the fires burning as a cook in the fortress. But when the fortress is attacked by the demonic army of the Ice Kingdom, the people and the flame are in danger of being snuffed out. Can Otr awaken a power that can turn the tide? A hero's journey of fire and ice now begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ランチどきは恋いどき

192768.description:
Ruscilester, a nightmare world where seven vampire sisters slaughter each other for supremacy. The key lies in "The Demon's Formula" — a conceptual weapon that shatters the world's laws by materializing the owner's twisted perceptions into reality. Shion, the weakest youngest sister, encounters a strange girl named Maroma during her mission to seize the formula from the werewolf Count Vezcacino. Maroma claims to be "human," yet she is a chimera possessing elements of both zombies and Frankenstein's monster.
This inexplicable encounter marks the beginning of the end for the nightmare world.

192769.description:
Henry and Jessie, roommates in the same army unit. Henry, who is very skinny, and Jessie, who doesn't care much about skinship, maintained a subtle friendship/comrade relationship. Then one day, during a betting game that started when he was very drunk, Jessie felt a strange sensation on his hand, and Henry looked at Jessie's hand with a sinister look...

Will the two be able to maintain their comradeship?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: ハンド・トゥ・ハンド〜陸軍ルームメイトのあやしい手〜

192770.description:
"I actually became a soldier to protect you."

A story of friendship and love between young soldiers in the midst of a brutal war.

(Source: Postype, translated)

192771.description:
Seo-Wu survives by selling information, living every day on edge. One day, a suspiciously friendly operative who leads with emotion instead of caution shows up at his door. Yi-Jin is clearly dangerous, probably even from a rival organization. And yet… they talk far too easily.

Between a high-strung informant and a disarmingly open operative, a risky connection forms... Is this pull part of the mission, or something dangerously real?

(Source: Lezhin US)

192772.description:
This is the 562nd time I've killed this guy. Hundreds of years ago, Dong-Yi was forced into immortality by the monster 'Shin-Young'. Every time, he looks for a chance to get revenge on Shin-Young, but it's nearly impossible to kill the immortal, so they live together in a strange state of near-death. However, one day, after killing Shin-Young, who always gets on his nerves, Shin-Young, who he should have returned alive with a smile, doesn't return...

Dong-Yi goes out to look for him with an anxious heart, but when he meets Shin-Young again, he strangely seems to have lost his memories of him...?

"If you forget me, how am I supposed to get revenge...!"

192773.description:
One day, a handsome man wearing a martial arts outfit appears in front of the manager of the martial arts idol group 'Gupilbang', Jeom-So-Ui. The man, who introduces himself as 'Cheonma Wi Hwa-Jin', declares to Jeom So-Ui that he will become an idol out of the blue. Jeom So-Ui passes the problem on to Sa I-Bi, the head of 'Gupilbang's' agency K-tsch, but Sa I-Bi, a martial arts fan with a suspicious amount of money, decides to have Cheonma join 'Gupilbang'. Cheonma joins 'Gupilbang', which claims to be a political party! However, of course, there is a hidden agenda behind Cheonma joining 'Gupilbang' that Jeom So-Ui does not know about...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: The Heavenly Demon Became an Idol
The Heavenly Demon Becomes an Idol

192775.description:
Iris is a dropout in a family of magicians who cannot use magic. When her fiancé is stolen by her sister and Iris is forced to leave home, she finds work as a maid at a certain house. Soon after believing that her new life as a maid would be more peaceful than as a dropout, for some reason, her master, an extremely beautiful genius magician, takes a liking to her...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: My Step-Sister Stole My Fiancé, But Now The Genius Sorcerer Adores Me

It is okay for us to have illicit relationships, right? Even though I detest this flirtatious teacher, I can't resist his hot, piercing gaze.

192777.description:
Min-Ju, who has been unable to tolerate injustice since she was young, is stronger than anyone else despite her cute and small appearance and even has the skills to subdue her opponents. Then one day, at a freshman orientation, she mistakes her school junior Ju-Won for a pervert and ends up breaking his arm...! Worried about Ju-Won, who tells her not to worry as if it's nothing serious, Min-Ju decides to protect him until his arm gets better!?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 side story chapters.

192778.description:

(Source: Coolmic)

192781.description:
"It's obvious that you've wanted me this whole time." Ms. Saikawa's been crazy about her sexy coworker for a whole year. But when she finds out he's the company's biggest womanizer, will she fall into his trap, or just continue to admire him from afar?

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 9 episodes and 3 chapters respectively.

"Should I throw you into a cage?" He restrains me and sweetly tortures my nipples and my insides... I want to refuse, but I can't stop the excitement...!

(Source: Coolmic)
