However, after he is outed as gay, life at the office becomes difficult. His boss is emotionally manipulative, his coworkers talk about him behind his back, and even Higashikaneshiro ends up finding out that Kikuchi is gay. All this ends with Kikuchi quitting his job. On his last day, he finds himself really wishing the day would end already... but that's when Higashikaneshiro invites Kikuchi out for a going away party, just the two of them!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: We Are NOT Expensing the Hotel to the Company!
title.native: 経費でホテル代は落ちません!
title.romaji: Keihi de Hotel Dai wa Ochimasen!

synonyms: The Behavior Modification That Changed A Drunkard Lady's Life For The Better

title.native: 酔っ払いねーちゃんの人生が好転する行動変容
title.romaji: Yopparai Nee-chan no Jinsei ga Kouten suru Koudou Henyou

title.native: 酔っ払いねーちゃんの人生を彩る決意表明
title.romaji: Yopparai Nee-chan no Jinsei wo Irodoru Ketsui Hyoumei

192927.description:
I'm Endo, an office worker who has feelings for Konishi-kun, a construction worker ten years younger than me. Konishi-kun confuses me. He insists on having no interest in men, but his actions such as waiting in the rain and making lunch for me bring my hopes up. Even so, I should give up after telling him my true feeling... Right when I thought so, he says he is interested in how I beat off to him! If that's the case, will Konishi-kun let me touch his body just a little? Endo, who is chicken-hearted but comes through when the chips are down, and Konishi, who looks tough but is a pushover. A love story between two complete opposites!

(Source: INKR)

Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title "Itoshi no Nikkapokka (いとしのニッカポッカ)."
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: いとしのニッカポッカ

title.english: The Old Suit and the Roughneck
title.native: くたびれスーツと生意気ガテン

192929.description:
1. Ryousha no Ikemen Douryou wa Shikou no Playmate (寮舎のイケメン同僚は至高のプレイメイト, He Is My Supreme Playmate)
Sawatari was forced into the police academy and he is fed up with his life in an all-male dorm. One day, after complaining to his roommate Maihama about how badly he wants to get laid, the two end up fooling around, leading to a lesson in making love! It was never supposed to go further than touching each other, but Maihama can't help getting stirred up by Sawatari's sweet and innocent reactions...

(Source: Renta!, edited)

2. Bed Jou wa Muhou Chitai ni Tsuki (ベッド上は無法地帯につき, There Are No Rules In Bed)
3. Bokushi Kanraku (牧師陥落, The Fall Of A Priest)

Notes:
- This is an omnibus of previously self-published manga, commercially released by CLAP Comics for digital and Sankosha for print.
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: There Are No Rules in the Bedroom!
Bed Jou wa Muhou Chitai ni Tsuki
ベッド上は無法地帯につき
There Are No Rules In Bed

title.native: 寮舎のイケメン同僚は至高のプレイメイト
title.romaji: Ryousha no Ikemen Douryou wa Shikou no Playmate

192930.description:
Notes:
- Originally self-published under the title "Fujun Osu Ana Kouyuu (不純雄穴交遊)," was then licensed and compiled by CLAP Comics for commercial digital release and Sankosha for print.
- Chapter 1 has the same content as the first manga in the omnibus "Ryousha no Ikemen Douryou wa Shikou no Playmate (寮舎のイケメン同僚は至高のプレイメイト)."
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 寮舎のイケメン同僚は至高のプレイメイト 完全版
title.romaji: Ryousha no Ikemen Douryou wa Shikou no Playmate: Kanzenban

192931.description:
A man other than her husband forcibly pries her open and pushes into her…!
Even though she knows it's wrong, her body responds, and before she knows it, she is consumed by the pleasure!!
Is it a dream or reality? Six stories of married women who fall victim to forced intercourse!!!

(Source: DLSite, translated)

Included Stories:
欲しがり猥婦
会淫募集中
寝取られ願棒
悩家のお手伝い
マン引の代償
守られた交福

192932.description:
After a life of misfortune resulting in death at the hands of her sister, Calista, Harper wakes up again as her 8-year-old self. Realizing she's been given another chance at life, Harper is determined to stay out of the way and avoid becoming her sister's target. Unfortunately, her plan to go unnoticed goes awry when the sister who once hated her seems to be interested in her instead! But maybe this is for the better... if Harper can make Calista like her, she won't try to kill her, right?!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: My Sister, Who Was My Enemy, Now Loves Me

title.english: My Once-Enemy Sister Now Cherishes Me

192933.description: Our protagonist join Project Da Ai, the organization devoted to managing alien affairs on Earth.

192934.description: A second anthology of short comedic stories based on the visual novel Mahoutsukai no Yoru.
synonyms: Witches On The Holy Night Comic à la Carte [Witchcraft]

title.native: 魔法使いの夜 コミックアラカルト ウィッチクラフト編
title.romaji: Mahoutsukai no Yoru: Comic à la Carte Witchcraft-hen

192935.description:
TYPE-MOON's newest visual novel is now available as an anthology comic drawn by talented artists. Get a glimpse into the lively daily lives of the witches who reside in the mansion on the hill.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Witch On The Holy Night Comic à la Carte [Nursery Rhyme]

title.native: 魔法使いの夜 コミックアラカルト ナーサリーライム編
title.romaji: Mahoutsukai no Yoru: Comic à la Carte Nursery Rhyme-hen

192936.description:
Since we don't know when, our world is being invaded by an alien power. It seeks to magnify and manipulate the dark desires that lurks in the souls of the people in this world, by taking over the bodies of eight beautiful and talented young women. The girls gained supernatural powers, even as their souls are being consumed by lust. By coincidence, all of them have set their sights on the bright and handsome boy Wu Se! Now Wu Se must protect himself and find a way to fight back while being "surrounded" by these powerful girls!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Please Save the World With a Date

title.romaji: Qing Yong Yuehui Zheng Jiu Shijie

synonyms: My Mama and I gave Birth While I was in Elementary School! Omake!

title.native: 親子で小〇生で妊娠して赤ちゃん産んじゃいました テレビでは過激すぎてカットされた未公開映像集
title.romaji: Oyako de Sho〇sei de Ninshin Shite Akachan Unjaimashita. Terebi de wa Kagekisugite Cut sareta Mikoukai Eizou Shuu

192938.description:
Sold to the Nineth Nether Demon Hall as a child, He Yun grew up safely thanks to his honesty, hard work, and culinary skills. However, in the middle of an ordinary day, in broad daylight, he was forced to "XX" by the sect's leader!

(Source: Tencent Comics, translated)
synonyms: Secretly Cultivating by the Demon Cult Leader's Side
The Evil Cult Leader Hid Beside Me and Watched Me Practice Secretly

title.native: 魔教教主苟在我身边看我偷偷修炼
title.romaji: Mojiao Jiaozhu Gou Zai Wo Shen Bian Kan Wo Tou Tou Xiulian

192939.description:
After leaving the city behind, Jeong-Won returns to his seaside hometown of Samcheonpo. There, he meets Do-Jin, a runaway college student with a bad first impression and nowhere to go. When Do-Jin ends up staying at Jeong-Won’s house under the pretense of teaching him to swim, the two begin an unexpected cohabitation by the sea. As summer unfolds, their awkward start slowly turns into something tender - like the calm waves that bring them closer each day.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: It's Easy to Fall Into Samcheonpo

192940.description:
Straightforward guy photo and college student Kang Chan X prickly former pianist Ye-Jun. A love story that is louder than music begins!

Kang Chan was forcibly dragged to his nephew's piano recital as a cameraman. The moment he was bored while holding the camera— delicate fingertips, eyes that you can't take your eyes off, overwhelming melody. His eyes, his heart, stopped at the man playing the piano on stage. "Please be my photo model!"

Straightforward from their first meeting. Manners? None. The mood? Smashed. Of course, Ye-Jun rejects him outright! But Kang Chan doesn't know how to give up. He immediately enrolls in a piano academy and starts to hover around Ye-Jun. Bickering, excitement explosion!

A love story clearer than a camera, starting now.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: The Point that Touches the Fingertips

192942.description: Note: 7 Pages Short Story Published on the Author's Pixiv account.

title.native: 魔法少女お母さん七変化
のじゃロリババア狐さまのもり
title.romaji: Noja Loli Babaa Kitsune-sama no Mori

192944.description:
When their parents suddenly remarried, Haruka and Saori suddenly became sisters. Haruka had already quit her job and was living with her parents, so she thought that Saori, who was cool and focused on her work, lived in a different world... but then she was suggested to live together!
The distance between the two of them grows closer as Haruka helps out her "older sister" Saori with the housework, which she is not good at. Saori, who longs for family ties, also enjoys getting to know her "younger sister".
But Saori has a secret. She is a "real yuri" and has fallen in love with the easygoing Haruka at first sight. If she'll found out, Saori might lose the family bond she has worked so hard to obtain, and Haruka... She can't say it. But she wants to get closer! A certain incident takes a sudden turn in the days of these two step-sisters!?
The girls' love comedy about these two step-sisters begins!

title.native: 新しくできたお姉さんは、百合というのが好きみたい
title.romaji: Atarashiku Dekita Onee-san wa, Yuri to Iu no ga Suki Mitai

192945.description:
Sakura Kouzuki, a top-tier gyaru who's the star of the class and even works as a reader model, and Houri Kazami, who prefers talking otaku stuff with his comrades in the corner of the classroom. These two, who seem to live in completely different worlds, are actually step-siblings—and secretly live together as a couple. And none of their classmates know the truth. While Sakura sparkles at school, once she's home she relaxes completely and falls head over heels for Ori's cooking. And Houri, who’s in charge of meals, doesn’t mind one bit—— “Simmered fish is sooo good~♡” “Onii-chan's cooking really is the best~!” A sweet and fluffy feeding story about a cute gyaru and their double life at school and at home!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: クラスで一番かわいいギャルを餌付けしている話
title.romaji: Class de Ichiban Kawaii Gal wo Ezuke Shiteiru Hanashi

192946.description:
8th year student, Holden Pilgrim has gone missing. As head of Gabriel House, it is Jade Devon’s duty to see to it that he’s found. But when the affable yet mysterious Lei gets involved, is he trying to help or hinder the investigation? Jade has seemingly caught Lei's eye but is this just an innocent attraction or is something more sinister lurking beneath the surface...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

192947.description:
In a world of immortal cultivation fraught with peril, Su Jin strictly adheres to the principles of caution and steady progress, diligently avoiding disaster. His path changes dramatically when he gains the ability to traverse different worlds. "A realm where martial arts reigns supreme? My immortal techniques will overpower all and sweep aside any opposition. I will expand my harem and seize the world's essence transforming it into fuel for my own cultivation! I may be greedy, selfish, lustful, and sometimes murderous... but I am a benevolent immortal! My name is — Su Jin!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Cultivation of Immortality Begins With Immortality

192948.description:
Esen's death was only the beginning. After saving Cliff from her father's cruelty and being forced to become his wife, her life ended while giving birth to her enemy's child. But fate wasn’t finished with her. When she wakes up in the past with knowledge of the future, Esen is determined to rewrite her fate and change her relationship with Cliff, who was once her enemy and is now her greatest challenge. Can love truly rise from the ashes of hatred?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: A Spring Breeze in a Wasteland

192949.description: "Phyllis — I want you to be my wife." Phyllis has worked as a royal court enchanter for three years, devoting nearly every waking moment to her demanding job. Even holidays are just another workday. But one day, her trusted fiancé suddenly breaks off their engagement—claiming he's found his "true soulmate." Heartbroken and at a loss, Phyllis encounters a visiting prince from a neighboring kingdom who unexpectedly offers her a contract marriage. Thus begins a romance born from convenience, where mutual benefits spark something much deeper.

title.native: 偽装結婚のはずが愛されています～天才付与術師は隣国で休暇中～
title.romaji: Gisou Kekkon no Hazu ga Aisareteimasu: Tensai Fuyojutsushi wa Ringoku de Kyuukachuu

192950.description: “Why me? Why am I the one being sentenced to death?” With eyes burning with rage and hatred, Catherine stood on the execution platform, staring at the world that had betrayed her. Three years ago, Catherine was sent from her homeland, Woltilla, to the Kingdom of Highland as the Crown Prince’s wife. But instead of a peaceful royal life, she was caught in filthy conspiracies, framed for crimes she never committed, and sentenced to death. Her tongue was torn out during torture, leaving her voiceless in her final moments. The crowds cursed her, screamed at her, and rejoiced in her suffering… And in the midst of this overwhelming injustice and pain — her head fell, and her life came to a tragic end. But fate had other plans for her… When she opened her eyes again, she found herself back in time — three years before her death, right at the moment when her tragedy first began. “This is an opportunity I can’t waste!” And so begins Catherine’s cold and graceful revenge, determined to bring down every single person who betrayed her — one by one. A royal revenge story… of a woman wronged by everyone, now returned to become their worst nightmare.

title.english: The Princess Returns From Death and Exacts Her Brilliant Revenge
title.native: 死に戻った妃は華麗なる復讐を遂げる
title.romaji: Shi ni Modotta Kisaki wa Kareinaru Fukushuu wo Togeru

192951.description:
Silver Lining is a custom-made suit specialty store located in Ginza. The store manager, the self-centered assistant manager, Ryoji, is in charge of proposing suits for each and every customer. The customers who visit the store come with a variety of different circumstances and requests...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

192953.description:
Hinata, an office worker, is left all alone after her brother, with whom she lived together, suddenly dies. One day, her brother's best friend, Yuune, appears before Hinata. And then, to her surprise, it's her brother, Asahi, who has become a ghost! The three of them end up living together, but...

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title.native: 陽だまりシェアハウス
父さんが借金を妻の体で補填して欲しいと言われたので快諾した話
title.romaji: Tousan ga Shakkin wo Tsuma no Karada de Hotei Shite Hoshii to Iwareta no De Kainoku shita Hanashi

192955.description:
A kindergarten where superpowers are a daily occurrence. The temporary teacher who was assigned here, Oh Sae-Ong, has no superpowers, no experience, and no physical strength. He endures each day among the children who light fires, call for water, and see the future, and gradually learns about their world. A kindergarten routine that is more special than special abilities, Super Power! Care Diary

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

192956.description:
I have to stop this. I can't let my friend be killed...! - Meiko Yashiro is in her second year of junior high. She's barely spoken to her childhood friend Hozumi Togawa ever since a certain incident drove them apart. However, one day Meiko has a supernatural encounter that could change everything... "I can't let his life end at 14 years." - One girl will spring into action to change her childhood friend's future in this time-paradox coming-of-age story that will pull at your heart strings and leave you blinking the stars out of your eyes!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

192957.description:
Fiona, the most powerful magician in the empire, was tired of being overworked on the battlefield every day, both physically and emotionally. She thought she had given up her life on the battlefield, but when she woke up, she found herself under the protection of Matthias, the most powerful knight in the enemy kingdom!

In this powerful and loving fantasy, Fiona recovers her life while receiving love and tenderness for the first time!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 人生に疲れた最強魔術師は諦めて眠ることにした
title.romaji: Jinsei ni Tsukareta Saikyou Majutsushi wa Akiramete Nemuru Koto ni Shita

192958.description:
A young man named Yuki, who is looking for work, sees a poster in a coffee shop saying "We're looking for a voice actor manager." Yuki, who knows nothing about anime or voice actors, is taken to the dubbing site by Kunugi, who works as a manager.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: For You in the Recording Booth

title.native: アフレコブースの君たちへ

192959.description:
A martial artist who was reincarnated as the Four Guardians of the Sun Palace, grasping the blade of vengeance.

In a time of war, "Seonhwayun" had the power. He gathered his agenda, Confucian scholars, and six colleagues to purge the corrupt emperor and nobles, and establish an empire where the people would not starve. He placed Confucian scholars on the throne, and gave his six colleagues the positions of the Six Kings of the World to support Confucian scholars. However, Confucian scholars and the Six Kings of the World, who were afraid of the rising status of the Confucian scholar Confucian scholar Confucian scholars, joined forces to kill Confucian scholar Confucian scholar Confucian scholar. Did the gods accept Confucian scholar's resentment? Confucian scholar Confucian scholar Confucian scholar reincarnates as the Four Guardians of the Sun Palace and sharpens his sword of revenge.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

192960.description:
Kiyoshi Kimura is the president of the sushi chain Sushizanmai. One day, Sushizanmai's president Kimura is led by a mysterious voice and transported to another world. When he serves sushi to the hungry villagers, an unexpected event occurs...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 異世界すしざんまい マグロ大王木村社長、食を通じて異世界改革！
title.romaji: Isekai Sushizanmai Maguro Daiou Kimura Shachou, Shoku wo Tsuujite Isekai Kaikaku!

192961.description:
Exhausted office worker Itsuki has two secret joys in life. The first is feeding the stray cats at the convenience store on his way home from work. The second is having the gorgeous clerk ring him up. That was how Itsuki got himself through his boring everyday routine. However, on one such boring day, his routine is unexpectedly broken. He learns Fumio, the gorgeous clerk, has dependency issues... on him...!

This manga features a clingy younger top with no common sense and an older bottom with a soft spot and a yearning for pleasure! One night, Itsuki decides to break the monotony of his daily routine and invites the much younger Fumio out. At their dinner, however, he learns the truth about who Fumio really is...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: A Gorgeous Convenience Store Clerk's Twisted Love
title.native: とある美しきコンビニ店員の偏愛
title.romaji: Toaru Utsukushiki Kombini Tenin no Henai

192962.description:
Min-Jae, who gave up his dream of becoming a teacher due to an incident during his days as a teacher. Now a cafe owner, he meets Hye-Seong, who was his cute student during his days as a teacher, at a class reunion. Hye-Seong, who has become a screenwriter, needs to write a sex scene, and his teacher asks for Min-Jae's help by making an absurd suggestion to date him for two months. Min-Jae thinks it's ridiculous to date a former student, so he pushes Hye-Seong away, but Hye-Seong keeps violating Min-Jae's safety line...

"This is my first time experiencing something like this... Teacher, what's my score right now?"

Will Min-Jae be able to push away Hye-Seong, who has gone from a cute student to a bold and straightforward younger man?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
synonyms: Caution! Do Not Cross the Safety Line

192963.description:
Ashiya, who is studying at the same art university's video department, started taking up photography after being invited by his high school friend Hayama. Wanting to talk to someone about the strange events that have occurred in the photos taken by Hayama, Ashiya tells his story to Tsukinami, a student in the Japanese painting department who is knowledgeable about the occult and horror.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 美大生・月浪縁の怪談

192964.description:
Dutiful Ren is serious about her job as a government employee, to the detriment of her own love life. Relationships? No time. Sex? Never had it. But she can’t help but feel she’s missing out on something special. Then a charming, incredibly handsome man named Makoto comes to her rescue as she’s being harassed late one night. Enraptured by his pretty face and enchanting words, Ren finds herself following him to a love hotel and finally has her first time! And oh, what a time…Makoto is not only gentle, he seems to know her most sensitive spots. For a one-night stand, it’s truly epic—until Ren and Makoto meet again, and she finds out he’s a well-known tea ceremony master. Could something more be blooming between them?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: The Tea Ceremony Master’s Rich and Steamy Service: Spoiled by His Skillful Hands
title.native: 茶道家男子の濃厚エッチなおてまえ　～極上な指遣いで溺愛されちゃうっ
title.romaji: Sadouka Danshi no Nouko Ecchi na Otemae: Gokujou na Yubizukai de Dekai Sarechaou

192965.description:
In a small village deep in the mountains of Shikoku, there is a strange Buddha statue that is strongly worshipped. Hayato comes from Tokyo to the village to accompany his friend Takumi on a trip back home, but he feels something is off about the villagers' strange cold demeanor... Takumi's grandmother warmly welcomed him and they were enjoying a peaceful dinner together. But the moment he heard her say that he had "brought Buddha closer", Takumi's face turned pale and he ran out of the house - disappearing that night.
From then on, Hayato becomes embroiled in a series of strange events.

title.native: 辺境警備 前史〜銀のイリュージオ〜
title.romaji: Henkyou Keibi Zenshi: Gen no Iryuujio

192967.description: After an old family friend shows up to throw Kaede and her ninja family out of their secluded mountain home, the three of them must brave a new world - Tokyo - and fight off malicious goons to stay safe.

192968.description:
Sarah, moves from the countryside to the capital, Lytton, to work as a gardener. On her first day in the city, Sarah encounters trouble when her luggage is stolen, and then meets a girl in a wedding dress...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

192969.description:
Rikka Miku, a first year junior high school student, has a childhood friend named Shiraha Kou, who is kind and handsome, but has a bad mouth. After entering junior high school, Kou becomes a member of the school's idol group "Colors", which is made up of four good-looking boys, gets his ears pierced, and hangs out with a flashy senior. Miku becomes worried and asks Kou about Colors, but he warns her not to get close to the members. In fact, the members of Colors, including Kou, have a secret...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: ヴァンパイア♡溺愛パラダイス

192970.description: The series re-imagines the cast of Fate/Zero as cute super-deformed characters who open a cafe, led by Saber as the manager.

title.native: Fate/ゼロカフェ ～Fate/Zero Cafeに集う英霊達～
title.romaji: Fate/Zero Cafe: Fate/Zero Cafe Tsudou Eireitachi

192971.description:
Mangaka Kouji Mori reminisces about his life with his deceased best friend, Kentarou Miura.

Note: Originally published in the "Messages to Kentarou Miura" booklet, released with the 2021 #18 issue of Young Animal magazine.

title.native: モリちゃん ケンちゃん 0話

192972.description:
Jian ZhiXi enjoys arranging fates for other immortals, but one day, she lost control of her own destiny and became trapped in a relationship with Lord Deity Cangling, who demanded her company along his journey in the mortal realm. Never for once had she been able to escape from him. Lord Cangling, please let me go. I’m just a nobody... Wait, why is this cold-hearted man now becoming so warm? What is he going to do with me...

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Iceberg Upper God Is Begging to Let Things Slip by
Icy Upper God Please Let Me Go

title.english: Lord Deity, Please Let Me Go!
title.romaji: Bing Shan Shang Shen Qiu Fang Guo

192974.description:
After three years of marriage, I found my husband is a two timer and did not want to hide his betrayal any more. I tried my best to please him and save the marriage but all I have done is far less important to the other woman - his first love in his eyes. Finally, I abandoned myself and chose another path of attack. At this time, the man I met was like a landscape that opens the door to my new world. He said to me, "There are so many a**holes in the world. If I hold your hand tight, you won't be afraid."

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Qing Shen Bu Di Chen Nian Hen

192975.description:
In this multiverse, an infinite number of parallel worlds coexist. People and things are exactly the same in every world. But the same “person” has a different identity in each world. He can be one of the nouveau riches, a hobo, a national leader, or a wanted criminal… When one day you arrive in another parallel world, where another “you” are a tycoon, you can take his place and enjoy an extravagant lifestyle! No one will notice that because you have the identical fingerprints, iris patterns, and DNA....

(Source: Webnovel)

192978.description:
After being driven out of the entertainment industry by online trolls, she decides to return home to inherit her family's fortune. Anti-fans, "Family's fortune? What’s her background? What kind of wealth does she have?" CEO of the Luo Group—worth billions—tweets, "She is my biological daughter." Anti-fans, "W-what?!"

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: After I Lost My Job, I Went Back to Inherit Hundreds of Millions of Properties

title.english: I Returned Home to Inherit Billions of Fortunes after Losing My Job
title.native: 失业后我回去继承亿万家产
title.romaji: Shiye Hou Wo Huiqu Jicheng Yi Wan Jiachan

192979.description:
The advent of demons and other foul beings during the twilight of the last age ushered in an era of carnage and destruction that ravaged the lands everywhere.
Wuxin was expelled from Mount Longhu where his long wandering journey began.
Despite knowing that he should keep to the code of not giving help without receiving proper compensation in return, Wuxin often himself compelled to jump into people's aid out of his own kindness.

(Source: Webnovel)

192980.description:
A high school girl is transported into a game world and transformed into a ten-year-old girl. She got a mission to develop a relationship with the prince regent who always killed her in the final of the game. Therefore, she had to start to win his affection when he was still a nobody. However, he despised her very much, which made the mission more difficult...

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Love Is the Only Way to Stop You From Going Dark

title.native: 只有恋爱才能防止黑化

192982.hashtag: #意地っ張りな先輩のしつけ方

title.native: 意地っ張りな先輩のしつけ方

synonyms: サイコ・アナ♂バスターズ

title.native: サイコ・アナ●バスターズ

192984.description:

192985.description:
Garam has a secret desire she can’t let anyone discover. She only ignites with pleasure when she’s pushed into submission. When Hasung, her brother’s friend, finds out, he makes a dangerous offer. “Want me to help? Then open your mouth.” From that moment, their secret affair begins. But soon, another younger man, Woojae, her friend’s brother, steps between them. Now trapped between two younger lovers, Garam can’t escape the forbidden triangle that has begun.

(Source: Lezhin US)

192986.description:
For struggling idol Hana, a late-night variety show invitation feels like a golden opportunity. Sure, the program is infamous for its over-the-top content, but exposure is exposure... Right? With cameras and staff all around, what’s the worst that could happen? The answer comes fast and shocking. The hosts and fellow guests clearly didn’t get the memo about “professional boundaries.” Suddenly, the games and skits spiral into outrageous territory, the kind of risqué chaos no public broadcast should ever attempt. Hana can only stare in disbelief as the so-called “entertainment” blurs every line between performance and scandal. Is this still a variety show or some twisted after-hours experiment? And most importantly, are the cameras really rolling right now?!Between shock, embarrassment, and unintended hilarity, Hana is caught in the most unpredictable “broadcast” of her life. One thing’s certain: this is late-night TV like no one ever imagined.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

192987.description:
I'm here to protect the lady of the Ruslan household... through all dangers and perils.

(Source: Toomics)

192989.description:
Gay office worker Takahiro is in love with his colleague Miyabi. He thought they could just stay friends, but when he hears a rumor that Miyabi has a girlfriend, he is heartbroken. Still, he loves Miyabi, so he goes out drinking with her whenever she invites him out... When Takahiro wakes up drunk, he finds himself at Miyabi's house!? When Miyabi touches his hand to take off his suit, Takahiro becomes aroused and gets an erection, and for some reason Miyabi ends up jerking him off... An office love story that begins with unrequited love and physical contact between a gay office worker who falls in love with a straight man.

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

192990.description: On her fifth birthday, Sallestia remembers her previous life and her life of poverty with the shock of a blow to the head... And now, to her surprise, she understands that she has been reincarnated as the villainesss in an Otome game! "I was poor in my previous life, and now that I've been reincarnated as a nobleman's daughter, I'm going to enjoy all the luxuries!" But... The servants and villagers of the estate are all skinny and on the verge of starvation...? I can't allow myself to be poor in my reincarnation! I'll use magic to reform the estate and make the villagers and myself rich!

192991.description:
It’s known to all that the new online celebrity Xu Ling, who relied on Zhou Yanhuai to be famous, is extremely ignominious. What’s more shameful is that she is actually proud of it! “Miss Xu, Mr. Zhou possesses a high social status, why did you sell him easily?” “Have you experienced being ignored for 4 years (1461days)? Have you even been refused for three years(1095 days)? I’ve loved him for seven years, I... I’m not going to love him any more.”

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Mr. Zhou, Forced Marriage Is Illegal!

192993.description:
Awakened from their eternal slumber, ancient beings now known as vampires rise from the frozen soil, driven by human greed and madness. Now in a battle for survival, humanity turns to forbidden experiments on their own bodies. But will they transcend their limits — or become the monsters they so fear?

(Source: Manta)

192994.description:
Mun-Hak, the bassist of Earth Square, has always stayed away from fans, especially with his leader’s strict “no groupies” rule. But when a flirty fan named Jae-Hui catches his eye, Mun-Hak can't say no. What starts as a fleeting encounter soon spirals into a risky, passionate affair that could ruin everything.

(Source: Manta)

192995.description:
Geon-Ho, a conman who marries the innocent single mother Ji-Hye in order to steal her fortune. The only son Jin-Su, whom he encounters on the first day he enters her house, is a large, reclusive loner. After Ji-Hye goes to work, the door to Jin-Su's room, which had been tightly shut, opens, and Geon-Ho is dragged into the room by Jin-Su, who does not recognize him as his father...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
synonyms: [Adult BL Short Stories] Bad Papa Playtime

192996.description:
MV Mulsan's only son, Jae-Won, unfortunately has no interest in business and wanders around. His father, who dislikes such Jae-Won, takes in Han-Jin as his adopted son, offering to pass down the company to him. Jae-Won asks about this and that in an unexpected situation, but no one gives a proper explanation, and Han-Jin answers with a kiss, confusing Jae-Won...?!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
synonyms: It's an Honor to Be in Charge of Teaching

192997.description:
Jin-Woo and Do-Young, two brothers who became brothers without a single drop of blood related to them due to their parents' remarriage. Do-Young didn't like the fact that his older brother was always perfect to the point of being perfectionist when he suddenly appeared. However, Jin-Woo, who knew that his younger brother's bullying was actually his affection for him, provokes Do-Young, thinking that his feelings will break his perfectionism...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

192998.description:
Kwon Ga-Eul, the younger brother who always lets someone with a similar face to his brother into his room. The only one who has not been able to enter his room is his step-brother Seo Yi-Sol who lives with him.

"Can you sleep with me? If you don't want to, then don't cross the line."

It has been 6 years since Ga-Eul was unable to cross the line drawn by him, and Yi-Sol wants to cross that line.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
